anatoly fyskov.name: Anatoly Fyskov
anatoly fyskov.origin: Anatoly Fyskov is a Russian businessman deeply involved in a covert geopolitical struggle between the United States, Canada, Russia, and Japan. In 1885, while these nations publicly claim to be cooperating, each secretly seeks to sabotage the others in a bid to secure a vast oil reserve that could shift the global balance of power. Fyskov becomes a target when Japanese operatives attempt to assassinate him in Chicago, but he survives the attack. Later, he arrives in Alaska at the location of the oil-rich mountain, intending to claim it for Russia. However, he encounters the Sunset Riders, who recognize the danger of such a resource falling into the wrong hands. In a climactic showdown, the Two-Gun Kid triggers explosives that destroy the mountain and its oil reserves, ensuring that no single nation can control it. Fyskov, along with U.S. agent Killerman, is caught in the blast and presumed dead.

anatoly petrov.name: Anatoly Petrov
anatoly petrov.origin: Dr. Anatoly Petrov was a writer and lecturer on superhuman studies at Lomonosov Moscow State University. While working on a book about Doctor Doom, which was going to state that Doom was the greatest villain of all time, he was confronted by Kang the Conqueror who believed he was the greatest villain, not Doom. To prove Petrov wrong, Kang took Petrov through time to demonstrate his abilities. During their trip, Kang was informed that there was a disturbance in the timestream. So, Kang took Petrov to Oracle Base to investigate the disturbance, which he learned was caused by Pirate Timeline 20208-Manticore-Green. Then Oracle Base was attacked by Avenger Prime's Deathloks, forcing Kang and Petrov to flee. Petrov chastized Kang for abandoning the Pythians to their deaths that worked in Oracle Base. Kang ended Petrov's protests by lecturing him on his beliefs. After arriving in Earth-20208, Petrov and Kang discovered that the rogue timeline was being manipulated by Reed Richards, now going by Doom, using the Time and Reality Stones and the absorbed power of Celestials to reconnect it to the main timeline. Kang fought Richards but was overpowered. Before Richards could kill Kang, Petrov killed Richards with a spear. When Kang confronted Petrov for interfering with the fight, Petrov justified his actions that he was protecting his timeline and didn't care if Kang killed him for it. Kang spared Petrov, stating that he liked how Petrov stood up to him, which gave him hope for humanity. Kang then returned Petrov to his own time but warned that he would kill him if he ever wrote his book about Doom.
abilities: Expertise in superhumans.

anatoly ranskahov.name: Anatoly Ranskahov
anatoly ranskahov.origin: Eight years ago, Anatoly and his brother Vladimir were prisoners at the Utkin Prison in Siberia. They managed to escape, and set out to move to America. In the present, they were the leaders of "the Russians," a criminal organization located in Hell's Kitchen, specialized in operations involving human trafficking, and allied with Wilson Fisk. One of their cover ups, which helped with the distribution of Madame Gao's drugs, was a Taxi company called Veles taxi, which grew enormously when the owner of a rival company called Kitchen Cab, Mr. Prohaszka, was killed under the orders of Fisk, and their operations passed to Veles taxi. When a masked vigilante interfered in their activities, Fisk offered them to absorb their operations. At first they refused, and tried to deal with the vigilante by tracking down his ally Claire Temple. After Claire was rescued by the vigilante, and the Russians lost their only trail to get to him, Vladimir decided to accept Fisk's offer, for which he sent his brother Anatoly to seal the deal. However, Anatoly interrupted Fisk during dinner with Vanessa Marianna, forcing him to abruptly end the date. Fisk's men took care of Anatoly, and drove him to a location where Fisk beat him up for embarrassing him in front of Vanessa. Fisk ended up crushing Anatoly's head after banging his car's door furiously and repeatedly on his skull. His corpse was later found by the Russians, with the mask of the masked vigilante. Fisk had incriminated the masked man for Anatoly's murder to keep Vladimir and the Russian mob off-balance until he could get rid of them.
abilities: Like his brother, Anatoly spoke both and fluently.

anatoly rasputin.name: Anatoly Rasputin
anatoly rasputin.origin: When he was young, Anatoly Rasputin joined the Solntsevskaya Bratva. His brother Nikolai greatly disapproved of this decision, for which he cut off Anatoly from his life, to the point he never revealed his children that they had an uncle. Anatoly still kept up with the lives of his nephew and niece, Piotr and Illyana, as they went on to become superheroes and members of the X-Men, better known as Colossus and Magik, respectively. Anatoly's boss Viktor Komolov got involved in the magic arts and helped bring back to life the supervillain Omega Red; however, the ritual carried out to this end could only bear temporary results. Because of this, Viktor and Anatoly devised a plan to take advantage of his relationship with Magik, who was a powerful sorceress. Under the pretense he was warning the X-Men about Komolov's activities, Anatoly meet up with Piotr and Illyana in Russia, and the X-Men observed from a distance. The reunion turned out to be an ambush, and Komolov's men kidnapped Magik. Anatoly tried to further play Piotr, and offered him to take him to Komolov's hideout. Piotr accompanied Anatoly, pretending to be his prisoner. When Viktor ordered Anatoly to kill Piotr, he was ready to comply. However, the X-Men intervened, because they were wary of Anatoly's true intentions. Following the defeat of Viktor and Omega Red, Magik was rescued, and Anatoly was arrested. He was taken to the Lefortovo Prison.
abilities: Black Magic: Anatoly has gained some degree of knowledge in the black arts, courtesy of his boss Viktor Komolov.

andamo.name: Andamo
andamo.origin: Andamo was a Zingaran swordsman who was was captured in Yezud along with Welyn and Moru, but they were eventually freed by Daedikaron, Tros, Ixastophanis and Shimata-Kawa. After killing a horde of Demons sent by Tolometh, Andamo received a vision to search for the amulet in Shan-E-Sork, west of Aghrapur. Andamo was later fighting for Lord Pollus in Charnina and recruited Conan into the Pollusites. Andamo was loyal to Lord Pollus only to retrieve the amulet shard which fell from Sutekh's charred remains, despite the death of his lover Moina. Preferring to serve a god, he switched sides and allied with the Patriarch of Tolometh, who named him his bodyguard, and Little Shadow, which chanted to him a song about Tolometh's return. He confronted his fellow seekers when they entered the Patriarch's inner sanctum, dueling to death with Moru.

anderson schultz.name: Anderson Schultz
anderson schultz.origin: Anderson Schultz and his wife Eliza were billionaire philanthropists. Their only son David became a United States Senator who developed and prospered in his political career with the help of his wealthy and connected family. When Russian businessman Nikolay Poloznev tasked Sergei Konchevsky to obtain compromising material on David in case he became the President of the United States, Konchevsky hired a woman named Fiona who in turn had her gang of young con artists infiltrate a funeral that Schultz attended and take photos of him kissing another man. When Anderson and Eliza became aware of this, they send John Pilgrim to retrieve the photos and kill everyone who stood in his path. Pilgrim intercepted the gang as they were about to deliver the photos to Fiona and killed everyone except Amy Bendix who happened to be outside and escaped with the photos. Anderson then tasked Pilgrim to continue his mission and find the girl, who by then was under the protection of Frank Castle. For their role in causing numerous innocent deaths, Castle eventually tracked the Schultzes down and killed Eliza, leaving Anderson to commit suicide.

anderthorp henton.name: Anderthorp Henton
anderthorp henton.origin: Henton was a renowned hedonist, frequently relaxing in holo-drama starring himself as the virile hero over a brothel of scantily clad super-heroines from the Heroic Age. He also had a tendency to openly discuss classified corporate information in front of secretaries or other staff, then casually murder them to preserve the secrecy. As Alchemax Director-General, he had appointed renowned hero of the Pollution Wars Paul-Philip Ravage as Eco Central Police Force's Commander, who had no idea about Alchemax's illegal and environmentally unfriendly (but very profitable) practices. After Ravage began asking too many questions about Alchemax's illegal activities, Henton publicly branded him as a Polluter traitor, and turned into an outlaw. Although the frame-up was successful, the elimination was not, and Ravage became a growing thorn in Alchemax's side. C.E.O. Avatarr eventually had Henton murdered for his failures, and turned his responsibilities over to Darrly King, who became C.E.O. of Eco Central.

andras.name: Andras
andras.origin: Andras was born sometime in the 14th century. He was a normal human, but his son Dafydd was born as a mutant. Unfortunately, Andras's wife died while giving birth. Andras and Dafydd were living together in a small village in the south of Wales. In 1347 the Black Death spread into the village. The villagers blamed it on Dafydd, believing what he was a "changeling" (a child replaced by the faeries). The villagers wanted to sacrifice Dafydd, in order to stop the plague, but Andras refused to give in to their demands, so they set fire to his home, killing Andras and nearly killing Dafydd.

andras bertesy.name: Andras Bertesy
andras bertesy.origin: Andras Bertesy was a prominent arms dealer throughout central and eastern Europe, making a fortune out of his business. He also dabbled in human trafficking, drug trade, became a master in dark arts and venerated the Dweller-in-Darkness. He traded part of his access to Darkforce Dimension energies to an Al-Qaeda cell in order to use it in means of teleportation and carry out an attack to the United States of America. The attack was foiled by S.H.I.E.L.D.'s own Avengers unit, but Hawkeye was captured by Bertesy's soldiers, though he didn't know anything because of the memory implants S.H.I.E.L.D. used on him made him forget the mission. In the end, Black Widow rescued Hawkeye, after killing Bertesy and his soldiers.

During a transaction between him and the famous thief, Andrè asked Black Fox if that would be the last time they would do business together, and Black Fox replied that it was true and that the proceeds from that transaction should have guaranteed him a quiet retirement, but during their speech the police arrived at Boullion's door and ordered him to open because they had a warrant. When the police raid, Boullion tried to slow them down by giving Black Fox the opportunity to escape by telling him to hurry up and not to worry about him because his lawyers would take care of his defense. After his release from prison thanks to his lawyers, Andre met again with Black Fox celebrating his release and proposed a deal to him, Andre had to recline as the police still suspected him and for at least six months he would have to give up his trafficking. Shortly after their meeting, Andre was found murdered and Spider-Man blamed the murder on Black Fox. Spider-Man later learned from Chance that himself had been the perpetrator of Andre's murder because he refused to join his employer's intelligence network.

andre cocteau.name: Andre Cocteau
andre cocteau.origin: During World War II, Cocteau acted as a double agent for the Allies, working within the Third Reich. Cocteau worked directly for the infamous Red Skull. Believing him to be kidnapped, Captain Sawyer sent Logan and Captain America into heavily occupied France to retrieve him. They discovered the Red Skull and his plan to create an army of super-androids. Meeting tough resistance, the two barely manage to fight their way free, thinking Cocteau betrayed them. Logan vowed revenge. Decades later, Wolverine learned that Cocteau had died. He traveled to France and discovered from Cocteau's daughter Justine that he was a spy and single-handedly sabotaged the Red Skull's plans. Wolverine then scratched "Hero" onto his tomb.
abilities: Brilliant scientist

andre gastrade.name: Andre Gastrade
andre gastrade.origin: Younger Man|thumb|left Ghost Dancer was a centuries old sorcerer from the Caribbean. He was recruited by U.S. Army Major Alan Dakor, alongside Emerald Warlock and Agatha Harkness, to join the Department of the Uncanny and help stop the threat of Hilda von Hate. The group allied with the Invaders and traveled to Tian where they killed Hilda and defeated her Zombies. The Ghost Dancer married Grace and decided to settle down and retired from magic. When Hilda seemingly resurfaced in modern times, the still youthful Emerald Warlock visited Ghost Dancer and they teamed up with the Avengers Unity Division to stop the zombie curse being spread from the site of her first defeat, discovering the source of the disturbance to be Erida, the Goddess of Hatred. They defeated her and Ghost Dancer sensed the evil within the Emerald Warlock and the two returned to his farm where the Warlock killed the Ghost Dancer.

andre leclare.name: Andre LeClare
andre leclare.origin: Monica Rambeau worked as a New Orleans Harbor Patrol lieutenant and, as a black woman, faced difficulties to ascend to the rank of captain. Fate came upon her one day when she met Professor André LeClare, a friend of her late grandfather, who approached her seeking help in retrieving a energy-draining device which had been usurped by his rogue assistant, Felipe Picaro. Rambeau traveled with LeClare by bravely captaining a boat to a Roxxon oil rig on the Gulf of Mexico. She infiltrated the oil tower by gaining Picaro's trust. Regrettably, LeClare was found by security guards when trying to deactivate the dangerous mechanism, revealing their plan. When Picaro attempted to use the energy disruptor to obliterate Fort Benning, Rambeau destroyed the equipment with her bare hands and gained superpowers by being bombarded with extra-dimensional energy.

andre mornet.name: Andre Mornet
andre mornet.origin: Andre Mornet was cursed to become the Wendigo after being trapped under a tree in the woods and eating his own fingers to survive. The Wendigo attacked Wolverine in the Weapon X Facility. Andre was temporarily freed of the Wendigo curse when Lorenzo Scoggins performed a spell to claim the curse while retaining his intelligence. Andre was found by a group of campers and was trying to explain his story when Larry's spell was reversed, changing Andre back into the Wendigo. Andre eventually found his death during a three-way battle against Mauvais and Wolverine when the Canadian necromancer ripped out his heart and ate it to absorb the power of the Wendigo. Mauvais then brought Andre's corpse back to life and used it to fight Alpha Flight, but it was destroyed when Wolverine disrupted Mauvais's magical ritual.

fields.unusual_features: As the Wendigo, Mornet was large than the average human, was covered with snowy white fur, had a long tail, razor sharp teeth, and claws on his hands and feet.

He and his followers were successful in establishing order in their area of California. Minister Ogada was unable to maintain order at home, however -- his wife was a devoted Thorite whose faith he could not sway. Ogada's wife and their youngest child, Krystalin, left him and the Soldiers as Krys was growing up.

andrea haggard.name: Andrea Haggard
andrea haggard.origin: Phillipe Bazin was a crimelord whose operations were plagued by Darkhawk's attacks. He hired Andrea Haggard to be subjected to experiments granting her the power to manipulate magnetism. She fought Darkhawk, and in the ensuing battle severely wounded Chris' friend, Headset. thumb|left Later, when Darkhawk's amulet had been torn out of his chest by Tombstone, she fought and easily defeated him, However, after being captured by Lodestone and Bazin, Darkhawk's father sacrificed his life in order to free Darkhawk. Lodestone was defeated and Bazin presumed dead. Lodestone later appeared as a member of the seventh incarnation of the Masters of Evil, and later still as a member of Hank Pym's anti-Ultron Lethal Legion.

But she was called in by Director Maria Hill to help investigate the death of one of their own, Agent Damon Dran. Andrea wondered why Hill wanted her to handle this since she was only a researcher and that the mission seemed quite dangerous for someone of her experience. left|thumb|Hill with Agent Hope Hill explained that Andrea had applied for operation status three times and she knows what it was like to be overlooked. After giving her a field agent promotion, Andrea asked if the death of Dran involved Chaos at all, but Hill did not know, all she had was a file which included classified details about Michael Collins and the Deathlok program.

andrea margulies.name: Andrea Margulies
andrea margulies.origin: Andrea Margulies was one of the youngest students at the Xavier Institute. Prior to the invention of the school's training squad system, Rubbermaid was one of Emma Frost's numerous advisees. While Bishop and Sage were visiting the X-Mansion during a murder investigation, Rubbermaid and fellow students Tantra, Gloom, Silicon, and Overlay decided to play pranks on the two X-Men. Rubbermaid attempted to wrap herself around Bishop, but he managed to subdue the girl. Emma Frost revealed that Jeffrey Garrett, a mutant accused of murder, had won Andrea's heart. He was the reason why Bishop and Sage came to the X-Mansion. When they arrived again, Andrea wrapped herself around Jeffrey after he was shot by Sage so he would receive no further harm. When Jeffrey woke up, he told her to run, but she would not leave him. When Storm and Emma arrived, the children were all gone. The two rushed to the Danger Room where Bogan, the group that Jeffrey killed, were. Oliver, aide to Mr. Bogan, had an unconscious Rubbermaid in his arms. left|thumb|100px|Andrea dies Following the formation of training squads, Rubbermaid was assigned a new advisor, Northstar. Andrea and her fellow students, Anole, Loa, Indra, Kidogo, and Network, were placed in Alpha Squadron, wherein they trained together as a team to develop their powers. When a brainwashed Wolverine seemingly killed Northstar, former New Mutant Karma took over as the squad's advisor. Andrea questioned Karma's ability to advise the Alpha Squadron due to her busy schedule as the teacher of the lower school and interim advisor to the Paragons. In order to help assuage their grief, Xuân showed Andrea and the rest of her squad the statue of Northstar erected in his memory. After M-Day, Rubbermaid lost her powers, earning her a seat on the bus back home. As the bus was departing, however, Stryker fired a missile at it. The bus was destroyed and all of the depowered students inside it were killed, including Andrea. As a victim of anti-mutant violence whom the X-Men regretted being unable to save, Andrea was considered a high-priority mutant for resurrection on Krakoa. She was seen reuniting with old school buddies. ===Paradise Lost=== After Andrea was abducted while attending a salsa festival in Austin, Texas, Professor X and D-Cel recruited Juggernaut and his Unstoppables to rescue her. Unfortunately, the The Warden also hired Deadpool to "rescue" Rubber Maid and deliver her to his prison, the Dungeon. They escorted her safely to a Krakoan Gateway.

weaknesses: Her powers give her the same setbacks as rubber, for example, if exposed to great heat she will 'melt' and if exposed to great cold she will begin to freeze. She could also be harmed by bladed weapons.

andrea pearson.name: Andrea Pearson
andrea pearson.origin: Andrea Pearson was a councilwoman for New York City. Her niece was one of the hundred of missing people whose blood was used by Muse to make a mural which was later planted in Freddy Durnin's warehouse. After learning that Durnin planned on created a private exhibit and charge people to see such gruesome piece of art, she visited him and tried to convince him to refrain from proceeding with his plan, on behalf of families struck by the mystery surrounding the painting's origins. When Durnin refused, Pearson used her political influence to ask the D.A. office to find a way to shut down his sideshow. A.D.A. Matt Murdock was assigned to the case. Pearson was later kidnapped by Muse and taken to the sewers together with the judge in charge of her case, for trying to prevent public access to his mural. They were rescued by Blindspot and escorted to safety. Thanks to Blindspot's bravery, Daredevil was able to catch the Muse and rescued all the people he kidnapped to create his mural, including Pearson's niece, as he had kept them alive to drain more blood to use as painting.

andrea roarke.name: Andrea Roarke
andrea roarke.origin: ===Stockpile=== Andrea Roarke, alias Sunstreak was a fire wielding criminal who once battled Iron Man as part of the Stockpile team. ===Initiative=== After the Civil War, she was given the choice of going to prison or joining the 50-State Initiative to be trained at Camp Hammond. ===Secret Invasion=== Sunstreak along with the Initiative recruits and the Young Avengers went to New York City to fight the Skrulls and were quickly overwhelmed. Sunstreak was put onto a team led by Tigra to catch Stegron, who was attacking S.H.I.E.L.D. bases all over the United States. After their first attempt to catch Stegron in South Dakota failed. They later caught him in Wyoming. Sunstreak was later disgusted when opening her graduation papers and learning she was to remain for further training, alongside Prodigy. ===Dark Reign=== She later joined back with Force of Nature, who was made as part of the Initiative as the Oregon team, and was made leader of the team. She participated to the sanction-offensive of the Initiative against the seceding Heavy Hitters and later to the H.A.M.M.E.R. assault on Asgard. Her status after Osborn's dismissal is unrevealed, but Steve Rogers thought of using Butterball's connection with Sunstreak, and thought about integrating her into the team in order to reform her.

andrea rodgers.name: Andrea Rodgers
andrea rodgers.origin: left|thumb|Andrea's multiple personalities Andrea Rodgers was a troubled teenager whose difficult upbringing, marked by parental conflict, religious guilt, repression, and emotional trauma, contributed to the fragmentation of her psyche into five distinct personalities. During a camping trip in the swamps near Citrusville, the mystical energies surrounding the Nexus of Realities intensified her inner conflict, causing her alternate selves to manifest physically. These personae included Circe, embodying Andrea's sensual desires; Miranda, representing reason and self-control; Patti, the frightened child within her; Snake, her aggressive and masculine traits; and the She-Demon, the living expression of her rage, resentment, and suppressed hostility. Acting independently, the personalities repeatedly placed Andrea in danger and often came into conflict with one another. When the manifestations spiraled out of control, the Man-Thing instinctively recognized them as fractured portions of a single soul. One by one, he forced the personalities back into Andrea, reuniting the divided aspects of her identity. With her psyche restored, Andrea sought medical and psychological help, hoping at last to become a whole person.

andrea sterman.name: Andrea Sterman
andrea sterman.origin: Andrea Sterman was a psychiatrist who drove away her husband, who took her son with him, because, in her words "she could analzye everyone in the world but herself." She was hired by the Commission on Superhuman Activities to determine if Jack Monroe presented a danger to society. Saving his life by contacting Captain America, she continued to work for the CSA. She was assigned a new partner in Jack Norriss, and the pair contacted U.S. Agent about capturing Nomad. She was also a professional writer who wrote "American Dreamer", a book about the urban hero Nomad, crafted by looking into his past as Jack Monroe. Her next book involved a deep probe into government conspiracies and nearly got her killed. She was taken in by the V-Battalion for her own protection after an assassination attempt, and became something of a voluntary prisoner among the organization for many months. fields.history: Andrea Sterman was a psychiatrist who drove away her husband, who took her son with him, because, in her words "she could analzye everyone in the world but herself." She was hired by the Commission on Superhuman Activities to determine if Jack Monroe presented a danger to society. Saving his life by contacting Captain America, she continued to work for the CSA. She was assigned a new partner in Jack Norriss, and the pair contacted U.S. Agent about capturing Nomad. She was also a professional writer who wrote "American Dreamer", a book about the urban hero Nomad, crafted by looking into his past as Jack Monroe. Her next book involved a deep probe into government conspiracies and nearly got her killed. She was taken in by the V-Battalion for her own protection after an assassination attempt, and became something of a voluntary prisoner among the organization for many months. Years later, she was asked by the Avengers to become Moon Knight's psychiatrist, eventually coming to accompany the entire Midnight Mission.
fields.notes: Andrea Sterman is a smoker.

andrea timly.name: Andrea Timly
andrea timly.origin: Andrea Timly and her meek husband Nathan had a deep interest in the occult and in particular one of the most powerful books of dark magic ever created, the Darkhold. Jack Russell's father, Gregory, was a known scholar and researcher of black magic, as he tried to find a way to reverse his lycanthropy and was believed to have possessed the Darkhold before he died. The Timlys believed that Jack was told the location of the powerful book by his mother upon her deathbed. Attempts by Jack to tell the Timly's that all he had learned from his mother was the origin of his curse proved futile as Andrea was convinced that Jack knew where the book was. She desperately wanted the Darkhold to realize her own dreams of power, and resorted to torturing the young man in order to discover its location. During one such instance, her servant Kraig struck out against his master, Nathan, accidently killing him. Jack was able to escape in the aftermath, and later fought Kraig in the form of the Werewolf by Night. After Kraig's failure to recapture Russell, Andrea tried to summon long-dead gods without the information she needed from the Darkhold and apparently perished in the attempt. After dying, for her effrontery, Timly was tortured by dark gods' servants even in death, to the point of carving the pages of the Darkhold on her body and forcing her to become one of them herself. Now rejuvenated and calling herself Lady Darkhold, she returned to Earth with the objective of conquering New Orleans for her new masters, who, in exchange, would have made her its ruler; to do so, she possessed Legion of Monsters and made them into her minions to attack the X-Men team that was residing in Louisiana. She was defeated when Rogue stole her powers and Gambit restored the Legion's minds using the Eye of Agamotto. She then went unconscious and was seemingly handed to the Scarlet Witch, the Sorcerer Supreme.

andreas de ruyter.name: Andreas de Ruyter
andreas de ruyter.origin: Andreas de Ruyter came from the family that for at least two generations was obsessed with capturing a Wind Rider. Andreas considered his father and grandfather to be loony terrorists, and refused to follow their steps, unlike his younger brother Claude, who continued their mission. Andreas instead joined the Bureau of State Security of the South Africa. One day he was given a mission to buy Vibranium from the Wakanda, but was unable to even enter the country. Andreas was stopped and seriously beaten on the border by King T'Chaka, who refused to sell anything regardless the price. His disgrace was witnessed by young Prince T'Challa. Andreas retired from service and wasted the next ten years fighting bulls in arena, trying to forget his humiliating defeat. One day Claude contacted him to tell that he found a Wind Rider, young street thief Ororo Munroe, and needed Andreas' help to capture her. Andreas agreed to help, they tracked down the urchins and mercilessly killed all the kids and their Teacher, leaving only Zenja, who told them that Ororo left with the Prince T'Challa of Wakanda. Andreas vehemently hated Wakanda ever since his defeat decade ago, so he became much more interested to capture T'Challa, compared to Wind Rider, as he hadn't really believed in her powers. It lead to a conflict between brothers, because Claude wanted to kill T'Challa, while Andreas wanted to capture and exchange him for Vibranium. Andreas went after T'Challa, but was defeated by him and then Claude shot him with tranquilizer. Claude then tried to kill the prince, but was defeated as well. Andreas, however, later captured Ororo and used her as a hostage to force T'Challa to surrender. They both were chained and put on helicopter. On their way, Ororo unlocked the chains, but during the following fight Andreas and T'Challa fell out of the helicopter. Ororo jumped after them, using the strong desire to survive and save T'Challa to forcefully awaken her powers. She stroke Andreas with lightning and then summoned powerful wind to hold herself and T'Challa and let them land safely, while Andreas was seriously injured and partially paralyzed from the fall. Years later Andreas hired sniper to kill Ororo, who became a superheroine Storm. She defeated sniper, and went to meet with T'Challa who by then became the king. She informed him about Andreas and they tracked him down. Andreas created a robot to kill them both, but working together the two destroyed the robot. Andreas was controlling the robot with his mind, so its destruction backfired and killed him.

andreas kapelos.name: Andreas Kapelos
andreas kapelos.origin: Arms Merchant and an agent sold high-tech weapons to Don Fortunato's men. The transaction was guarded by Crimson Cowl's Masters of Evil, who were attacked by the Thunderbolts. Arms Merchant's agents tried to escape, but the Black Widow caught them. Kapelos' agents attacked Iron Man when he snooped around in the Dufours Precision Manufacturing Corporation hidden facility. He escaped them and went to Countess Stephanie de la Spinoza to ask her if she needed help. Stephanie's bodyguards turned out to be employees of Kapelos and attacked Tony and Stephanie. The Mandarin sent Dreadnoughts when he heard of Iron Man's attack on his weapon supplier. Iron Man fought Kapelos' agents and then saw Dreadnoughts destroy Stephanie's chalet with her still inside. Iron Man tricked the Dreadnoughts to attack Kapelos' agents. Stephanie and her butler had survived the attack and Iron Man later called the media to tell them he would reveal the illegal activities of the Arms Merchant. On his way to Kapelos, the Arms Merchant, Iron Man was once again attacked by Mandarin's Dreadnoughts. They followed him inside the hidden facility, where they were attacked by more of Kapelos' agents. Iron Man overheated the Dreadnoughts with molten steel and explained to Kapelos that the Dreadnoughts would soon explode and kill him. Iron Man lured the Dreadnoughts away after Kapelos gave him a coded disc with information on all his jobs. Iron Man couldn't find any useful information on Arms Merchant's clients.

andreas zorba.species: Human drawn to the Fearsome Fist of Farallah.
andreas zorba.origin: Count Andreas Zorba was a Greek aristocrat who was first seen as a member of the Collectors, a group of wealthy and ruthless collectors of rare and powerful artifacts. Zorba was introduced to the hero the Black Panther in the palace of Narobia by his fellow Collector Princess Zanda. The Black Panther became involved with the group when he and one of their number, Abner Little hunted for a magical water-skin that had the power of eternal life. When the two returned to the others with a portion of the artifact, Zorba and the other Collectors fought each other for possession of it. The artifact was, however, destroyed accidentally in the fracas. Later, Zorba approached the hero and entrepreneur Tony Stark for his help in locating a lost artifact in the Temple of Farallah in Canada. Stark refused at first, but was eventually forced to join forces with Zorba and his fellow Collectors. Inside the temple, Zorba seemed to disappear in a flash of light, but he had actually touched the artifact, the Fearsome Fist of Farallah, and been transformed into an Exemplar, calling himself Carnivore. Carnivore attacked his former allies, and was shot by Princess Zanda, before battling Stark's alter ego, Iron Man. Before the battle could progress further, however, two of Carnivore's fellow Exemplars appeared and spirited him away. Carnivore subsequently appeared in New York City with the other Exemplars, and the group clashed with the heroes Iron Man, Spider-Man, and Thor. The Exemplars attempted to create a device called the God Machine at the North Pole to enslave the minds of humanity. The Exemplars began to fight amongst themselves, however, with Carnivore taking on the Juggernaut. Carnivore and the other Exemplars then battled the Avengers, Spider-Man and Nova, and actually defeated the heroes. One of the Avengers, Captain America, however, persuaded one of the Exemplars, Bedlam to end hostilities, and the Exemplars departed. Carnivore later met his end when Black Knight lost control of the Ebony Blade and killed him.
powers: Carnivore possesses heightened strength, speed, agility, endurance, reflexes, dexterity, , and a , as well as fangs and claws that he could use as weapons.
abilities: Zorba was skilled in using firearms. In his Carnivore form, his ability in hand-to-hand combat was greatly increased.

andrei cutov.name: Andrei Cutov
andrei cutov.origin: When a catastrophic future was averted, the Mutant Liberation Army tracked Cable's energy signature to a safe house built by an older version of Cable and discovered that he had traveled to the past. Taking numerous chronal devices for themselves, they returned to the New Canaanites' headquarters where the Cronen were able to narrow the field within the timestream into which Cable had jumped, but not the location. Arriving in present day Transia, Stryfe struck a deal with the local government and placed MLA member Andrei Cutov within the ranks of the Transian Armed Forces to keep an eye on their new allies. Private Cutov was next part of a raid to round up mutants to be sent to his future as part of the government's deal with Stryfe in exchange for advanced weaponry and watched as his comrade shot a mutant in the head, which caused him to react by saying he didn't have to shoot the kid. Andrei was then part of a convoy that was transporting mutants to be shipped to the future when they were attacked by X-Force who destroyed the entire convoy and killed most of the Transian soldiers except for Andrei who revealed to them that he too was a mutant. Warpath confronted Andrei about betraying his own kind, but Andrei said that he was part of the transport in order to find a way to free them all from the tyranny of the Transian soldiers. Later Andrei explained to X-Force that he would help them infiltrate the Transian Federal House in order to look for their missing comrade. Andrei and a disguised Deathlok then drove one of the trucks to the Federal House as Andrei asked Deathlok some questions regarding Cable and mentioned that he looked familiar to him. Andrei and Deathlok made it to the compound in East Transia while Andrei told the cyborg to let him do all the talking. The soldiers approached the both of them as Andrei explained that they were part of the prison transport when they were attacked by the American mutants. Andrei provided his credentials to the soldiers, but knowing Deathlok didn't have any, Andrei shot and destroyed Deathlok's Image Inducer, betraying the cyborg and claiming that he had forced him to come there while holding him at gunpoint. As the soldiers dealt with Deathlok, this allowed Andrei to sneak away with ease. Andrei made it to the subbasement where the time portal was being held and used his pryokinetic abilities to kill the guards, before fleeing back to his own time period for reinforcements. After taking out the soldiers, Deathlok contacted X-Force to let them know that Andrei could not be trusted. Returning with the rest of the MLA to deal with Cable, Andrei and the others attacked X-Force. Andrei fought against Shatterstar who stated that that they had spared Andrei's life and for him to have turned traitor on his own kind made it no big surprise that he was allied with Stryfe. The battle ended when Cable surrendered upon learning that the Clan Chosen were being held hostage. Stryfe interrogated Cable, but to no avail, so he brought in Flintshard and used him as leverage to force Cable to speak, but when he still refused, Stryfe ordered Andrei to kill Flintshard, which Andrei did by burning him alive. Later Stryfe planned an assault on all the Clan Askani whom he tricked into returning to Ebonshire where Andrei and the rest of the MLA awaited them.

andrei gorlovich.origin: Andrei Gorlovich was a Russian mobster and drug runner. He was one of several men responsible for authorizing the execution of scientist Ho Yinsen. Gorlovich was also personally responsible for murdering Yinsen's wife, right in front of the eyes of their young son. Yinsen's son, determined to get revenge upon Gorlovich, remote controlled Tony Stark and the Iron Man armor and had him assassinate Gorlovich.

andrew paperboy.name: Andrew (Paperboy)
andrew paperboy.origin: When Andrew was younger, he had a chance encounter with Matt at a local coffee shop. After witnessing Matt's mutant power to flatten and stretch himself, Andrew convinced Matt to join his company of superhero impersonators. Impersonating Mister Fantastic, Matt performed at birthday parties for supervillains and the children of C.E.O.s. Matt eventually got fed up with pretending to be a superhero and wanted to actually be a superhero. Matt suggested taking on the personas of "Dr. Val Ventura/Flatman" and wanted Andrew to be his sidekick, the Paperboy. Although Andrew had shown some romantic interest in Matt, he didn't believe he could succeed as a superhero and the two parted ways. left|150px|thumb|Flatman (Matt) (Earth-616)|Flatman sending a package to Andrew, inviting him to join the G.L.A. Years later, the Great Lakes Avengers reformed and became the only official Avengers team. Wanting to reconnect, Flatman sent out a newspaper with a story about the G.L.A. reforming and an invitation for Andrew to join them as Paperboy.

andrew ashendrew.name: Andrew Ashendrew
andrew ashendrew.origin: Andrew Ashendrew was a miserly landlord in Victorian England who evicted a dying woman who cursed him to endure ridicule. Upon leaving, he broke his spectacles and a stranger (presumably some version of Satan) offered to replace them. He saw a woman in a carriage whom he took to be lovely and tracked her down. He courted her, and she agreed to marry him. The bystanders mocked him, and he demanded to know why. The stranger appeared once more having repaired the man's spectacles. When the landlord glanced at his new wife, he saw that he had married a hag. The stranger explained that what he saw through his glasses was his own conceit.

andrew bhang.name: Andrew Bhang
andrew bhang.origin: Andy Bhang was the founder of a fledgling robotics company called Bhang Robotics. Despite having won the International Robot Soccer Championship, Bhang Robotics were effortlessly stomped by a new challenger, the child prodigy Tony Stark, leaving Andy both stunned and disgruntled. Over twenty years later, Andy was approached by Tony Stark to have him join Stark Unlimited as a key member of their Robotics Division, in part due to Andy's Idea-Based Structuring system (IBS for short). On his first day of work, Andy provided a key solution to defeat Fin Fang Foom. Not long afterwards, Andy learned that his punk rock idol Amanda Armstrong worked at Stark Unlimited, and was Tony Stark's biological mother. Despite a rocky start due to Andy being intimidated by Amanda, they began dating. When the launch of Stark Unlimited's latest product, a virtual world called eScape, was sabotaged by the combined, yet independent, actions of the Controller and the eScape's compromised operating system Motherboard, Andy worked on a blocking signal used to free every eScape user from the Controller's influence. During the incident, Amanda became trapped inside the eScape, and decided to leave afterwards due to the traumatic experience she went through. She offered Andy to join her, but Andy decided to remain at Stark Unlimited and continue following his dream to change the world with technology. Following the delegitimization of Tony Stark as a human being after he admitted to being a digital backup downloaded into an artificially-grown body, his company was seized by his older brother, Arno Stark and his business partner, Sunset Bain. Andy remained with Stark Unlimited after the merger solely to look after Jocasta, one of Andy's coworkers whose robotic body was under repair by Arno. During this time, robotic unrest surfaced on a global level, spearheaded by the A.I. Army. On the other side, Arno and Sunset became the premier forces of A.I. oppression. When Sunset accused Andy of helping the A.I. Army by feeding Bethany Cabe intel for her to relay to the rebellion, he lied and took responsibility, hoping it would help the real mole, and was fired. Andy was later visited by Machine Man at his residence to remove a submission code ingrained into Jocasta's programming that made her subservient to humans. Andy revealed that he had been put to work on the submission code while at Stark Unlimited, and had slipped a back door key into the program, which allowed Jocasta to return to normalcy. Afterwards, Andy and Machine Man were contacted by "Ghost in the Machine" (secretly Friday) who asked for the specs for Andy's program so it could be used as a counteragent against the submission code. Andy also gave his program to a remnant to the A.I. Army to be shared en masse. Following the downfall of Arno and Bain, Tony Stark regained control of his company. However, having decided that it had too much baggage, he decided to bequeath the Stark Unlimited HQ to Bhang Robotics, changing the building's logo to that of Andy's company as a surprise gift.

andrew black.name: Andrew Black
andrew black.species: Mutant enhanced by the Red drug
andrew black.origin: ===Early Life=== Andy was a mutant kid whose parents were contacted by Professor X when his abilities manifested but they refused to have him study at Xavier's School and chased him away. ===Super Soldiers=== Andy became a prizefighter, aware that his mutant powers gave him an advantage. After winning a fight against Terry MacLaren he took MacLaren's title, "the Guvnor", and was invited to enter an underground fighting tournament in the Savage Land, run by the Warlord, a Hydra leader and drug manufacturer. However, upon finding it was to the death, Black decided to escape. In doing so he encountered the Super-Soldiers and, after helping them destroy the Warlord's operation they recruited him into their ranks. ===Revolutionary War=== Andrew Black seemingly retained his mutant powers after M-Day. Along his teammates, he wrote a book about their lives, and was part of the crew of actors playing in the movie adaptation.

andrew breen.name: Andrew Breen
andrew breen.origin: Dr. Andrew Breen graduated from university with doctorates in parapsychology and xenobiology, and was immediately recruited by Weapon V - a Weapon Plus supersoldier initiative aiming to weaponize Symbiotes. Studying cloned samples of the Grendel symbiote, Breen used technology and research appropriated from other symbiote supersoldier initiatives in order to engineer suits of symbiote bio-armor that were bonded to operatives. Curious as to why the prototypes of the Sym-Soldier Program had failed, Breen determined that the symbiotes were linked through a hive-mind to a primordial god of darkness. While the other members of Weapon V dismissed his theory, Breen deemed it to be proven correct when the Grendel symbiote reawakened and rampaged through Manhattan. Desiring to see the world as the symbiotes did, he began appropriating samples of living abyss and using them as eye drops, an activity that gradually degraded his sanity. Seven weeks after the Grendel's rampage through Manhattan, Weapon V Headquarters was attacked by the symbiote-augmented serial killer Carnage - who had been bonded to a sample of the Grendel symbiote retaining its connection to the symbiotes' dark god. While Breen survived Carnage's attack and was evacuated by Mars Team, he was driven insane and developed the hypothesis that Carnage had been chosen as the God of the Everblack's demigod avatar. To prove this hypothesis, he surreptitiously manipulated Mars Team into engaging Carnage in combat and infused himself with living abyss. Fully succumbing to the corruption of the symbiote hive-mind, Breen openly betrayed Mars Team and offered them and himself as a sacrifice to Carnage.
abilities: Genius Intellect: While specializing in parapsychology and xenobiology, Breen was also adept at cloning and bioengineering.

andrew carpathian.origin: Andrew Carpathian was the descendant of Ambrose Carpathian, the founder of the Arcane Order of the Night and the one who brought and hid a swarm of carnivorous sentient insects from the Brazilian jungle to his mansion. Many years later the swarm was released on New York and it took the effort of some heroes to subdue and exile it into space. Andrew, now head of the Order, devised a system to bring the Swarm back to Earth using a diamond-powered machinery, but his ruse was opposed by the joint effort of Spider-Man, Black Fox and Doctor Doom.

andrew chaser.name: Andrew Chaser
andrew chaser.origin: Andrew Chaser was a freelance investigative reporter whose articles had appeared in various major newspapers. During his investigation into paranormals, Chaser met a CIA informant who briefed him on the facts about testing paranormal children and finding information about a former CIA agent turned rogue named Emmett Proudhawk. Andrew later went to investigate the Sanctuary site in San Francisco where many people had died in its explosion, but no trace of the boys with superpowers, of which he had found news on the Proudhawk File, where it was reported that a group of children paranormals were hunted by the government because their powers were uncontrollable. During the site inspection, he encountered Tyrone Jessup's astral form and together they went to the hospital where Tyrone's badly burned body was hospitalized and there Andrew played him a tape he had obtained by interviewing some people from the Foundations who mentioned about him and the other paranormal kids. Upon hearing from the Medusa Web, Scoop returned to Tyrone and told him that some of his friends might have survived but that a group of government-hired mercenaries were hunting them. Some time later, Tyrone met Andrew in a hotel in Los Angeles and there he confirmed that some of his friends were still alive and that the news had been given to him by a member of the Medusa Web who had offered to help him find them. However, Andrew pointed out that it was better not to totally trust people who worked on both sides of the fence. Andrew managed to get an interview with the leader of Medusa Web who honestly told him about the organization's purposes and what he wanted to do using the paranormals. Andrew later found out that he was being chased and had been for quite some time and they also knew that he was planning to publish a book on paranormals and government involvement, also when he met his CIA informant, before he was murdered by a sniper, he came to discover that his family was also controlled, and that the person responsible for all this was a very important person in the government and that he was himself a paranormal and that his name was Philip Nolan Voight. After being named President of the United States, Andrew managed to get a private interview with him in the nation's new capital of Denver. There Voight confessed to Chaser that he was indeed a paranormal but that he had lost his powers and revealed his intentions of domination and control by using the paranormals and at the same time threatening him and his family, convincing Chaser of the danger of that man and that it would have been appropriate that one day Voigt will have to be killed.

andrew christensen.name: Andrew Christensen
andrew christensen.origin: Andrew Christensen was an A.I.M. scientist who had infiltrated the U.S. military as a non-military project manager to assist with their new advanced control system for a pinpoint method of tracking U.S soldiers on the field, but who kept getting strange incidents. In fact, it was Christensen's sabotage that revealed his true nature when Iron Man asked Christensen for the password to control the system but he called in a squadron of A.I.M. Agents. Iron Man easily defeated them and when Christensen showed up with a pointed weapon a soldier behind him hit him with the butt of his pistol, stunning him.

andrew disanto.name: Andrew Disanto
andrew disanto.origin: Andrew Disanto is a TV journalist working for Channel 8 in New York City. His cameraman was named Jeff, and they had their own mobile unit. Supervillain the Beetle tried to frame Spider-man for the death of small-time criminal Terry Burns, whom Spider-man left tied in his web fluid. The Beetle then released Burns, who then died accidentally of an overdose; then the Beetle tied Burns in an imitation web fluid, so it would seem that Burns had died because Spider-man had tied him up and left. The Beetle stole the security tapes revealing his own presence, and provided a copy of the edited tapes to Disanto. To do so, the Beetle used the alias Jake N. Binners to approach DiSanto and met him in the George Stacy Memorial Halfway House, knowing well that Disanto would protect the identity of his sources. Disanto's exclusive images started the smear campaign against Spider-man, much to J. Jonah Jameson's chagrin. Soon afterward, Disanto made on-street interviews asking the question "Spiderman: Butcher or benefactor?", then was at Ryker's Island to report that Spider-Man had been arrested and was to be publicly unmasked (but Spider-Man escaped before that). Spider-man eventually tracked Disanto and took him from the mobile unit to literally shake him around and get information on Disanto's source for the images. Disanto ordered Jeff to film the scene, but Jeff was too shocked to handle his camera properly. Disanto told Spider-man about "Binners" and the address; Spider-Man left to eventually clear his name. Once fred, Disanto threatened to fire Jeff, but decided against it as long as Jeff could give a live report of Disanto speaking.

Soon afterward, Disanto made on-street interviews asking the question "Spiderman: Butcher or benefactor?", then was at Ryker's Island to report that Spider-Man had been arrested and was to be publicly unmasked (but Spider-Man escaped before that). Spider-man eventually tracked Disanto and took him from the mobile unit to literally shake him around and get information on Disanto's source for the images. Disanto ordered Jeff to film the scene, but Jeff was too shocked to handle his camera properly. Disanto told Spider-man about "Binners" and the address; Spider-Man left to eventually clear his name. Once fred, Disanto threatened to fire Jeff, but decided against it as long as Jeff could give a live report of Disanto speaking.

andrew henry.name: Andrew Henry
andrew henry.origin: Detective Andrew Henry was a detective for the LAPD during the 1940's. He was involved in the case of the infamous "Lady in the Lake" killer, and lamented that the case had since gone cold. At some point during his career, Detective Henry started covering up powerful people's mistakes for a price. One of these people was Calvin Chadwick, the owner of Isodyne Energy and senatorial candidate. Chadwick and his wife, Whitney Frost, paid Detective Henry to dispose of the body of Jane Scott, Chadwick's mistress. Before he did this, Detective Henry dressed up the corpse to look like a victim of the Lady of the Lake killer so the case would be re-opened. What he didn't know, however, is that Jane Scott was killed when she came into contact with Zero Matter, so the lake he dropped her body in froze after some time, drawing the attention of the SSR. Detective Henry tried to throw the SSR off of Calvin Chadwick's trail, but was eventually discovered to be connected to Jane Scott's corpse when he started showing signs of Zero Matter contamination. He then kidnapped Dr. Jason Wilkes, an Isodyne researcher working with the SSR, in hopes that he could "fix" him. However, his condition continued to worsen, getting to the point that anything he touched froze. Despite the SSR's orders not to fire at Detective Henry, a rookie cop (who happened to be getting paid by Calvin Chadwick and Whitney Frost) shot and killed him, shattering his body into small shards of ice.

andrew jones.name: Andrew Jones
andrew jones.origin: Andrew Jones was one of Arcanna's four children. They lived in a house specially shielded from outside influence, leaving the Jones family virtually unaffected by the Overmind war. Eventually, Arcanna and her husband Phillip moved their family to the newly constructed Squadron City to better protect them. There Andrew, his two older sisters, Drusilla and Katrina became good friends with Tina Stewart and Shape. Shape was mentally handicapped and the children adored him and he loved them very much. After the Squadron Supreme was trapped on Earth-616 for years and the fascist Blue Eagles took over their Utopia program, Andrew and her family remained hidden in their house until their mother returned. The Jones family is thought to have perished along with the rest of their world when it was destroyed during an incursion.

andrew king.name: Andrew King
andrew king.origin: Andrew King was a college professor of parapsychology and a colleague and boyfriend of Erica Fortune. He was aware of her telekinetic abilities, and when Erica received a grant to do research for her PhD in England and couldn't go because she had to look after her two siblings, Sally and Roy, Andrew offered to let the two spend the summer at his parents' ranch so she could go to England. It was then that two young aliens appeared from a dimensional portal followed by the demon Zxaxz and Andrew witnessed the first fight between Erica, who had become the Spellbinder and Zxaxz, ending with the demon's destruction. Having perfected her new powers, Erica went to university to surprise Andrew and show him her control over the powers. Andrew used the opportunity to study both the young alien Snugg and Erica's abilities in his laboratory and noted that her behavior was not normal. When Snugg challenged Erica to recreate Zxaxz in order to take the crown from him and become a true Spellbinder, Andrew tried to dissuade her but failed with Erica who recreated Zxaxz but this time she was unable to defeat him. After Zxaxz escaped, Andrew attempted to turn away reporters harassing Erica for an interview. Still harassed by reporters, Erica fled to her apartment where Andrew joined her trying to console her. Soon after Andrew agreed to accompany Sally as her father's substitute to a gathering of kids at Father White's Youth Club, not imagining that Father White had been possessed by Zxaxz. At the Youth Club, Zxaxz revealed himself and attempted to capture Sally to bring Erica out and Andrew participated in the fight with Zxaxz managing to save Sally from a fall while Erica and Zxaxz fought. After the fight Andrew scolded the reporters that they didn't want to leave Erica alone. More and more corrupted by power, Erica was getting closer and closer to insanity and Andrew's calming effect was also waning with Erica behaving in an increasingly extravagant and uncontrollable way even though he was always beside her taking care of Sally too. After yet another strange behavior that endangered her sister Sally, Andrew convinced Erica to give up the bracelet of order and the chaos that drove her crazy. Andrew took Erica and Sally to her cabin in Upstate New York to keep her away from Zxaxz. There Andrew discovers that Erica no longer needs the bracelets but she herself has the power. After Erica also discovered that she no longer needed the bracelets, Andrew convinced her not to go to New York by revealing that Zxaxz had killed some people and the affection he still bore her despite everything that had happened. Erica was convinced but just then a phone call came from Roy telling her that Zxaxz was in his pursuit, so Erica was preparing to launch herself to rescue her brother and Andrew told her that to fight Zxaxz she needed all the help she could get and gave to her the two bracelets. Andrew reached the scene of the fight between Erica and Zxaxz and he could watch only passively. At the end of the fight, Erica decided that for the good of all it was better if she disappeared along with Zxaxz and told Andrew who reluctantly had to accept it and has been taking care of her two brothers ever since. Years later, having agreed to take care of Sally and Roy, Andrew had an argument with Roy because he did not want to continue his studies but during the discussion a man possessed by Zxaxz showed up who transported everyone to his dimension. Prisoners in the dimension of Zxaxz due to Snugg's betrayal, but she did so in good faith convinced that if they returned the bracelets to Zxaxz he would leave them alone, Andrew and Sally were freed by Roy who used his powers and they all returned on Earth with Erica who was imprisoned in a crystal. Freed from the crystal, Erica did not recognize Andrew or her brothers and thought they were her captors, so she began to fight with her brother Roy and during their fight Andrew was hit by the rubble thrown by Erica's power, killing him.

andrew lewis.name: Andrew Lewis
andrew lewis.origin: Mad Thinker had Threska replace the wife of security designer Andrew Lewis. The Thinker then used Lewis' office in the Baxter Building to access the Fantastic Four's headquarters where he planted subliminal suggestions that the Fantastic Four would be dead within two years if they did not stop all their foes all at once. As planned, the number of villains the group began apprehending became too much for them to handle and Reed contacted Andrew Lewis to build a new Vault prison in the Negative Zone, unaware that Threska had infiltrated the Lewis home by murdering and replacing his wife. Once the Negative Zone prison was completed, the Mad Thinker and the other captured foes were all transported to it. After everything was in place, Threska used her connection to Andrew Lewis to stage a jailbreak, thereby freeing the Mad Thinker.

andrew meadows.name: Andrew Meadows
andrew meadows.origin: Andrew Meadows was one of a group of high-spirited, prankster students at M.I.T. who befriended a young professor Jenny Swensen. They helped her steal the MAX Armor that her late father had developed. Meadows and his friends dubbed themselves the Troubleshooters, and most of them developed their own MAX-derived technology to help Swensen in battling crime. Meadows designed a wrist-mounted device that fired laser blasts, which he dubbed Beam-Splitter. They helped Swensen on several cases, until they unwisely took on a terrorist, Steel Hawk, preventing him from assassinating the British Prime Minister. After that incident, the Troubleshooters planned to retire, but Steel Hawk came after them for revenge. He grabbed Meadows and killed him with his own Beam-Splitter weapon.

andrew sarkan.name: Andrew Sarkan
andrew sarkan.origin: Bruce Banner's tranquil time in Los Angeles is soon broken when he crosses paths with a boy named Mark Sarkan who is fleeing from his parents. He calls for help, but Dr. Andrew Sarkan and his wife subdue the boy and inject him with a sedative. Banner tries to intervene but they insist that the boy is their son and that he has a mental illness. As it turns out, Dr. Sarkan is the man he was seeking a medical assistant and Banner was hoping to apply for the job. Forced to accept the situation because he needs the work, Banner decides to pay close attention to find out the truth. Bruce manages to get the job as Sarkan is not overly concerned about references. Banner's job consists of monitoring and keeping Mark sedated, something that the Sarkan's insist is required. One night, Banner is woken up by the sound of screams and rushes out into the hallway. There he witnesses Dr. Sarkan being tossed out of a room. He asks what's going on and he admits that their "son" Mark is actually a shape-shifting member of the Dire Wraiths. He tells Banner how the alien ship carrying the boy crashed in their backyard one night. The entire crew except for the Wraith child were killed in the crash. Although they were initially horrified by the alien child, when it takes a human shape, they decided to adopt it. However, as "Mark" inched closer to puberty, his alien heritage started coming to the fore, including knowledge of his true identity. The boy, now calling himself Kattan-Tu, attacks Banner, triggering a transformation into the Hulk. The Hulk battles the Wraith, who tries various alien forms to fight off the gamma-spawned brute. However, the Hulk proves too powerful, he subdues Kattan-Tu long enough for Dr. Sarkan to inject a sedative, causing him to revert back into Mark again. When the Hulk calls Mark a monster, the Sarkans chastise the Hulk for this, telling him that he has a lot of nerve calling their son a monster. Furious and more confused than ever, the Hulk leaps away in order to get away.

fields.notes: While never stated, it is presumed that Andrew Stryker is a relative of William Stryker, given both have a xenophobia for non-humans and religious lanaguage used to describe his disgust for them.

andrew tebbs.name: Andrew Tebbs
andrew tebbs.origin: Not much is known about the past of the outlaw known as Hook Tebbs. At some point, he lost his right hand and began wearing a hook that was his trademark. He organized Outlaws Gulch, a secret town for outlaws to hide out from the law located in the Nevada's Rawhide Range. He amassed a group of loyal outlaws to help rob and pillage the surrounding area. Eventually, Hook's activities gained the attention of the Masked Raider, who with the help of the sheriff of Prairie City posed as a criminal known as "Streak". Acting tough before Hook's minion Tex and later being tough enough to strike at Hook, "Streak" was admitted membership into the group. Although Hook caught the Raider snooping around in the well they stored their loot and tied the hero up, the Masked Raider still got loose. Signaling the sheriff and his men to Outlaw Gulch's location, the Masked Raider subdued and tied up Hook. When Hook's men returned from a job, they attempted to flee the scene leading to shots being fired. The Masked Raider reported that Hook Tebbs was mortally wounded in the cross-fire.

andrew thatcher.name: Andrew Thatcher
andrew thatcher.origin: ===Origin=== Thug Thatcher was originally a New York based mob boss. He was shot in the shoulder in a gunfight with the police during an escape attempt. Thatcher's men found the office of Dr. Don Blake and his nurse, Jane Foster, and forced them at gunpoint to treat Thug. left|thumb Blake was more than happy to treat Thatcher, and he removed the bullet and stabilized him. However, Thatcher then directed his men to "take care of him" so he couldn't squeal to the cops. Blake managed to retrieve his walking stick, and he transformed into Thor. Thor captured Thatcher's gang, but Thug himself escaped and took Jane Foster hostage again. Thor rescued Jane and pursued Thatcher, eventually catching him in an old construction site. Thatcher was sent to prison. ===Zaniac=== Thatcher was eventually released from Ryker's Island and promptly took a plane to Chicago. He hired another criminal named Kellen to assist him. He tracked down his old girlfriend, Ruby, who now lived in Chicago with her two sons Kevin and Mick. The father of these kids was not revealed and may have been Thug himself. Thatcher forced Ruby to let him stay at her house and to assist in his plan to take revenge on Thor. He came upon the idea of freeing the criminal Brad Wolfe, alias Zaniac, and having him kill Jane Foster. However, upon being freed from his energy-nullifying manacles, the Zaniac slew Ruby, who walked in on them. Thatcher's agent, Kellen, responded by shooting and killing the Zaniac. However, the Zaniac's body began to convulse, and dozens of creatures burst forth, lunging for Thatcher and Kellen. The two fled, and Kellen tried to fight them off, but one of them attempted to bite Thatcher. He was prevented from being bitten by Thor and Justice Peace who traveled to prevent Earth-823019. Thatcher, however, had a heart attack from the vermin's unexpected attack, and he died.

andrew webster.name: Andrew Webster
andrew webster.origin: thumb|left|166px|Andrew Webster Andrew Webster was a schemer seeking easy riches and was willing to commit murder to do it. In 1943 he romanced a woman named Chloe who was from a wealth family that left her a fortune and a plantation home in Louisiana. He sought to marry the girl and then murder her in order to inherit her fortune. However, a rival suitor, a deformed man named Gus stood in his way. He managed to convince Chloe that Gus was a pest and she rejected him. Playing into Andrew's hands Gus vowed that if he could not have Chloe nobody would and he then retreated into the bayou. Andrew then developed a reptile costume which he would use in his scheme and succeeded in marrying Chloe. After the wedding he sneaked away and changed into the Reptile and attacked one of the wedding patrons, telling him to give a warning to all those that he would attack anyone who stayed at the plantation. Sure enough, over the passing days the Reptile struck again and again. Eventually Chloe called in the Human Torch and Toro who agreed to take on the case. Meeting with Andrew and Chloe, the two flaming heroes learned from Andrew that he suspected Gus of being responsible for the attacks. When the Torch and Toro went into the bayou to investigate, Andrew managed to convince his wife that he was going in to help them, but secretly changed into the Reptile again. There he confronted the two heroes and doused them with mud, extinguishing their flames and sending them falling into a quicksand pit. The Reptile then left them to die while he went to murder Chloe. However, the Torch and Toro were freed by Gus and stopped the Reptile and unmasked him as Andrew and revealed his plot. Andrew was then turned over to the authorities and presumably Chloe divorced him as she soon started a relationship with Gus shortly thereafter. Andrew's subsequent fate is unknown.

andreya cazeneuve.name: Andreya Cazeneuve
andreya cazeneuve.origin: Andreya Cazeneuve, or Andreva, was a rebellious underling of crimelord Zeelmo. At some point, she disobeyed Zeelmo and was imprisoned. android andy.name: Android Andy
android andy.origin: When the insane reality-warping mutant Mad Jim Jaspers took over the government of the Great Britain of Earth-238. Mad Jim Jaspers began persecuting other costumed paranormal individuals, having them hunted down and executed in order to make Britain a more safer place to live. After they became outlawed fugitives, Android Andy joined the fight against the oppressive regime running Britain and was among the group that were hiding in a secret location when the Fury attacked and began slaughtering everyone there. His remains were buried in a superhero graveyard, and years later Captain Britain passed by his tombstone.

android x 4.name: Android X-4
android x 4.origin: Android X-4 was an android commissioned by Nick Fury and created by Tony Stark to help find an A.I.M agent within S.H.I.E.L.D.. Nick Fury then seemingly accused Captain America of being the traitor, sending the Android to attack him. Captain America fought sufficiently against the Android, and Fury attempted to shut it down, but it continued to attack. Sharon Carter found the real traitor, Dr. Ryder, who had hacked into the Android and was now controlling him. With the traitor found, the android was deactivated.

andromache.name: Andromache
andromache.origin: Andromache was the wife of Hector, son of Priam, king of Troy. She and Hector sired a son, Astyanax. When Achilles sacked Thebe, he slew Andromache's father and seven brothers. Andromache tried to refrain Hector to go in the battlefront once, foreseeing his doom. After Hector was slain by Achilles, Andromache denounced the arrogance of Penthesilea of the Amazons, who had come to battle for Troy to cleanse her soul, and urged her to renounce facing Achilles, in vain. After the city had fallen, Odysseus advised to slay Astyanax, which Calchus supported and proposed to Agamemnon. Under Agamemnon's decree, Odysseus took Astyanax and let him fall from the rampart, causing Andromache to faint. Achilles' son Neoptolemus claimed Andromache as his prize in the War.

andrones.name: Andrones
andrones.origin: The Andrones were robots invented by Reed Richards of Earth-721. Their designs were purchased by Inter-Connected Technocracies Unlimited owner Albert DeVoor. DeVoor had been hired by Arkon of Polemachus to cause wars between Earth-616, Earth-721, and the Fifth Dimension, as the resulting destruction of all three worlds would power Polemachus for centuries. The Andrones were used to attack the Fifth Dimension but their forces were fended off by the Human Torch of the Fantastic Four. Arkon's scheme was ultimately foiled by the Fantastic Four.

andros.name: Andros
andros.origin: Andros was not so sure about attacking Peter Parker, because he thought that he was a normal human. Although he defined himself a soldier, under Bramer's orders he repeatedly hit Peter until Peter was bloody, and he only stopped when Peter fainted and Bramer gave the order to go away. That night, they ambushed Spider-Man at the Multivex and Andros hid in the shadows. When they attacked, he concealed himself in vapor to take Spider-Man by surprise. But Spider-Man grabbed his tail and ripped it easily, putting Andros out of fight. The day after he had again his tail and captured Peter Parker at Multivex. Distracted by Spider-Man, he was blinded by Peter's web, and then Spider-Man smashed him against Nardi, knocking both out. Some days after he was in an abandoned factory, but this time he was severely injured: he was missing his tail and had to stay on a wheelchair. He was caught in the pumpkin bomb's explosion.
powers: Andros was a cyborg with a robot snake tail and robot arms.

andy angel.name: Andy (Angel)
andy angel.origin: Andy was an angel from Heaven. An employee of Seraphim and Cherubim, Inc. who was trying to get his wings, he travelled to Earth to see if he could help someone out. Andy arrived in San Francisco on Christmas Eve. He landed at the Golden Gate Bridge to find a depressed Howard the Duck, who was contemplating suicide. Andy decided to try to boost Howard's confidence and morale by showing him how the lives of his friends would have unfolded if he had never arrived at Earth-616. He showed Howard Earth-83234, where they visited his friends Paul Same, Arthur Winslow and Beverly Switzler. To both Howard and Andy's horror, it turned out that all three of his friends would had been better off without him. Believing that he had failed in his mission and that his life was worse than Howard's because he now figured that he would never get his wings, Andy brought Howard back to the bridge and tried to commit suicide there himself, but this time Howard stopped him from doing so, thinking that Andy was even nuttier than he was. Howard offered to buy Andy a drink rather than have either of them kill themselves. Ironically, this act won Andy his wings because, after all, it was a successful mission.

andy clark.name: Andy Clark
andy clark.origin: Andy Clark was one of the replacements who arrived in Vietnam in February of 1967. One month later, Andy was introduced by Sergeant Polkow to Lt. Alarnick, their new platoon leader. The next month, Andy survived a mortar attack with Rob Little, then he later participated in a pacifying mission in South Vietnam. In June of 1967, Andy got to know the new replacement troops. Some time later, when Little was injured for trying to protect Alarnick from a grenade blast, Clark punched the officer out of rage. In August of 1967, Clark rescued Marine pilots Irish and Drum when their plane was hit by N.V.A. fire. Following this, at the 23rd's headquarters, Clark was then interrogated about Alarnick's death.

andy crockett.name: Andy Crockett
andy crockett.origin: Andy Crockett was a fur trapper and trader who was active during the days of the American Frontier. One day while out in the wilderness, he came across the savaged body of the Pawnee warrior known as Arrowhead, who had been seriously wounded fighting a bear. Andy took Arrowhead back to his people to be healed and established trade with them. Later, after Arrowhead's father was murdered by a white man, Arrowhead rode to nearby Sutter's Fort where he was mistaken from a Crow warrior and locked in the jail to be hanged in the morning. Knowing that Arrowhead was innocent, Crockett helped the warrior escape, although Arrowhead killed a soldier in the process making him an outlaw. The pair then rode back to the Pawnee tribe where Arrowhead learned that the local medicine man Snake Fang had usurped control of the tribe and orchestrated the murder of his father so that he could trade gold for alcohol with a trader. Arrowhead slew both Snake Fang and the trader, making himself a renegade of is people as well. Andy helped Arrowhead escape his tribe, but after everything Arrowhead experienced he vowed to destroy all white men, and the pair parted company. However, despite Arrowhead's vows to destroy all white men, he found a ready and willing ally in Andy Crockett who believed that Arrowhead was a genuinely good person. When Arrowhead was framed for murder and injured while being hunted down, Andy saved his life and brought Arrowhead back to his tribe to be healed. When Andy's equal treatment of Native Americans put him on the receiving end of the racist Marshall Ross Marney's noose, Arrowhead returned the favor and rescued Andy. Andy was later hired by the US Army as a scout to hunt down renegade Blackfoot warriors, Andy convinced the bigoted Colonel Brace to allow Arrowhead to assist them. When Arrowhead refused to slay innocent women and children among the Blackfoot tribe, Andy helped Arrowhead escape the soldiers to join the Blackfoot warriors in fighting the soldiers off. Later when Arrowhead was blamed for murders done by a band of renegade Cheyenne warriors, Andy warned Arrowhead that Major Cloud put a bounty on his head. In his last recorded appearance, Andy warned Arrowhead about the Pawnee warrior Black Buffalo's murder spree, prompting Arrowhead to eliminate his insane former friend. Andy's subsequent activities and fate are unknown. Despite Arrowhead's vow, Crockett has come to Arrowhead's aid on a number of occasions.

Arrowhead slew both Snake Fang and the trader, making himself a renegade of is people as well. Andy helped Arrowhead escape his tribe, but after everything Arrowhead experienced he vowed to destroy all white men, and the pair parted company. However, despite Arrowhead's vows to destroy all white men, he found a ready and willing ally in Andy Crockett who believed that Arrowhead was a genuinely good person. When Arrowhead was framed for murder and injured while being hunted down, Andy saved his life and brought Arrowhead back to his tribe to be healed. When Andy's equal treatment of Native Americans put him on the receiving end of the racist Marshall Ross Marney's noose, Arrowhead returned the favor and rescued Andy. Andy was later hired by the US Army as a scout to hunt down renegade Blackfoot warriors, Andy convinced the bigoted Colonel Brace to allow Arrowhead to assist them. When Arrowhead refused to slay innocent women and children among the Blackfoot tribe, Andy helped Arrowhead escape the soldiers to join the Blackfoot warriors in fighting the soldiers off. Later when Arrowhead was blamed for murders done by a band of renegade Cheyenne warriors, Andy warned Arrowhead that Major Cloud put a bounty on his head. In his last recorded appearance, Andy warned Arrowhead about the Pawnee warrior Black Buffalo's murder spree, prompting Arrowhead to eliminate his insane former friend. Andy's subsequent activities and fate are unknown. Despite Arrowhead's vow, Crockett has come to Arrowhead's aid on a number of occasions.

andy hartnell.name: Andy Hartnell
andy hartnell.origin: Andy was a young mutant attending the Xavier Institute. His freakish appearance made him vulnerable to jeers from bigots, and as such, his favorite day of the year was Halloween, when he could freely walk about the humans as if he were a person in costume. During one such Halloween, Andy befriended a girl his age named Amanda and her younger sister Sue. When Sue was grabbed by kidnappers, Andy revealed his mutant status by chasing down the kidnapper's van and saving Sue. While after her rescue, Sue viewed Andy as a hero and a friend, Amanda and the other humans met Andy with fear and disgust. Andy sadly returned to the Xavier Institute lamenting how Halloween always ends too soon. He was one of the many depowered due to M-Day and most likely killed when the bus exploded.
powers: Andy's physical mutation gives him increased speed and strength, able to chase down a speeding van and rip the van doors off their hinges.

At one point, he staged a party and invited many famous people, including Truman Coyote, Rebecca de Monkey, Buddy Gheko, Mel Gibbon, Whoopie Goldfish, Mick Jaguar, Barbara Mandrill, Barry Manitee, Meryl Peep, Dinah Saur, Cybill Sheepdog, and Bruce Springchicken (Englebert Hummingbird and Dr. Ruth Westhamster had promised to go, but they were not seen in the first part of the party). He stumbled into Jackal, who had adopted a secret identity as Black Jackal, leader of the masked Beagle Brigadeers, and invited him too. The party was crashed by supervillain Hobgobbler, who kidnapped one of the attendees - country western warbler Barbara Mandrill. Warthog tried to convince the Brigadeers to help Mandrill, but they were exhausted and had fallen asleep by then. It was Spider-Ham who saved the day.
