angel zamora.name: Angel Zamora
angel zamora.origin: Zamora was the virtual reality technician who worked for a studio in Lotusland where, however, the employees were used as their property. His technology was used to imprison the Hulk, but the latter managed to awaken his conscience to the point of rebelling and fighting the Crowd Control guards and in the fight he was injured. He was assisted by the Hulk who took him to a doctor to heal his wounds. Left paralyzed from injuries sustained during the rebellion, Zamora put himself in charge of the workers of the Lotusland studio making sure it remained a democracy and that no corporation was to get their hands on the studio by refusing any collaboration with them certain that the Hulk would support him. When Cybershaman sought the Hulk's support to destroy all electronic equipment to thwart the corporations, Quirk reminded the Hulk that the lack of energy would make Zamora's life support stop working by killing him, so the Hulk refused to help the Cybershamane. attacked him. At the end of the fight, zamora agreed to become the Democratic Leader of Lotusland. Zamora began therapy with Quirk's help to regain the use of her legs and had to counter the constant pricking of Keisha who aimed to become the leader of Lotusland. When Dr. Apolonio made a technological discovery, approaching his machinery, people began to behave in an unnatural way with respect to their character and Zamora also suffered its influence. Influenced by the power of Dr. Apollo, Zamora was devoured by artistic megalomania, seeing everything that happened as an extreme art, projecting his artistic ideas as a weapon against the Hulk, but with the defeat of Dr. Apollo by the Hulk and his weakening, Zamora and all the others returned to their normal character. Zamora was ready for the first Lotusland production since they ousted Draco, and it was the story of Rosa Palumbo, a past activist that the corporations tried to wipe from history, but with Doom's takeover of America, Zamora said that they would produce VR programs that told the truth about Doom starting with the 20th century Dr. Doom while temporarily leaving out the story of Rosa. After a heated discussion Zamora and Quirk smoothed out their differences and began to have a love affair with regret on the part of the Hulk who had affection for Quirk. Taking advantage of the momentary absence of the Hulk who was struggling on a Doom platform, Draco and his armies stormed Lotusland to regain power and caught Zamora and Quirk off guard. Zamora tried to resist guns in hand but failed and Draco's men kidnapped Quirk. At the end of the conflict, Draco was defeated by the Hulk and Zamora found an agreement with Doom, considering him the lesser of evils, but this greatly angered Quirk who told him that he had betrayed their dream, so he hit him and went away. Wanting Dr. Apollo's technology, Doom imposed his control over Lotusland by infuriating the Hulk who began fighting Doom's forces causing damage to the studio, Zamora then accepted Doom's terms and asked the hulk to leave the studios, even though he did. he realized that he had betrayed his own ideals of freedom and democracy. To get out of the impasse, John Eisenhardt pretended to kill Zamora by hitting him with a low intensity weapon thus giving him the opportunity to escape from a Lotusland now under Doom's control and to join Quirl in the Human tribe to be able to fight the corporations.

angela bradford.name: Angela Bradford
angela bradford.origin: thumb|left|Synario's real appearance A lowly office drone for Bert Gilmore's Gilsoft Games, Angela Bradford designed and built the MVRI, planning to use it to establish her own media empire. Needing some start-up money, Bradford tried to rob a bank, but when a teller hit an alarm, she activated the MVRI, transforming the bank into a dinosaur-filled jungle. When Spider-Man arrived, she fled back to Gilsoft, where Gilmore had enlisted the aid of lawyers Matt Murdock and Foggy Nelson to convince his employees to sign a work-for-hire agreement. Leaving the office, she conjured herself a garish costume and a new hairdo, and spotted Spider-Man swinging overhead. Incorrectly assuming he'd followed her from the bank, she conjured up an illusory volcano to distract him. Confronted by Daredevil, who had followed her from Gilsoft, she made the Man Without Fear appear to be a giant menacing "killer-droid". Allowing Spider-Man to "rescue" her, she watched as the web-slinger battled Daredevil. As she watched the heroes overcome the illusion, Bert Gilmore knocked her down and stole the MVRI. Spider-Man eventually recovered the device, after which both Bradford and Gilmore demanded it. Spider-Man took a Solomon-esque approach and smashed it, leaving both claimants to be taken away by the police.
powers: Synario's Mobile Virtual Reality Inducer (MVRI) allows her to project any image she can imagine
she can use this to alter her own appearance and the appearance of others, or to create images out of thin air. Blind people cannot perceive the images, nor do they show up in photographs.

angela cairn.name: Angela Cairn
angela cairn.origin: Angela Cairn was a New York City police officer who survived an attack by the mutate Vermin, who killed several police officers. Traumatized by this incident, Cairn tried to cover her pain and bitterness by becoming a tough cop. She was later drawn to a series of mutilations that strongly reminded her of Vermin and was captured by the "Mutilation Killer" and brought to its master Baron Zemo, who was responsible for creating Vermin and subjected her to his experiments. Angela was initially believed to have died from the experimentation and her body was disposed of in the East River; however, the experiment had turned her into a mute bat-winged entity known as Nocturne. She then encountered Spider-Man, who mistook her for the "Mutilation Killer", until the misunderstanding was cleared when she and Spider-Man battled and defeated the Mutilation Killer. She refrained from killing the Mutilation Killer out of revenge and allowed the Killer to be taken away by the authorities. When Spider-Man tried to convince Nocturne to seek help, she chose to go on her own way. Because of her condition, Nocturne found it impossible to continue living out her original life and took an earring that was given to her by her mother to help her remember who she was, while her loved ones believed her to be dead. She later befriended the Puma, a former enemy of Spider-Man, and stayed with him for some time. Nocturne once again encountered Spider-Man when the superhero was at a demoralized state. Unfortunately, the Puma went into a rage when he saw Spider-Man, causing a fight between them and accidentally slashed Nocturne across her face. After Puma fled, Spider-Man helped Nocturne and together went to find Puma. fields.history: Angela Cairn was a New York City police officer who survived an attack by the mutate Vermin, who killed several police officers. Traumatized by this incident, Cairn tried to cover her pain and bitterness by becoming a tough cop. She was later drawn to a series of mutilations that strongly reminded her of Vermin and was captured by the "Mutilation Killer" and brought to its master Baron Zemo, who was responsible for creating Vermin and subjected her to his experiments. Angela was initially believed to have died from the experimentation and her body was disposed of in the East River; however, the experiment had turned her into a mute bat-winged entity known as Nocturne. She then encountered Spider-Man, who mistook her for the "Mutilation Killer", until the misunderstanding was cleared when she and Spider-Man battled and defeated the Mutilation Killer. She refrained from killing the Mutilation Killer out of revenge and allowed the Killer to be taken away by the authorities. When Spider-Man tried to convince Nocturne to seek help, she chose to go on her own way. Because of her condition, Nocturne found it impossible to continue living out her original life and took an earring that was given to her by her mother to help her remember who she was, while her loved ones believed her to be dead. She later befriended the Puma, a former enemy of Spider-Man, and stayed with him for some time. Nocturne once again encountered Spider-Man when the superhero was at a demoralized state. Unfortunately, the Puma went into a rage when he saw Spider-Man, causing a fight between them and accidentally slashed Nocturne across her face. angela daskalakis.name: Angela Daskalakis
angela daskalakis.origin: Angela Daskalakis was headmistress of the Alchemax School for Gifted Youngsters in Westchester County, New York. She oversaw the education of Kron Stone, Xina Kwan, and Miguel O'Hara. Kron's escalating bullying against the other students reached the point of attempted murder, and Angela personally stepped in to knock the homicidal Kron into submission. Angela brought Kron before the student review board for disciplinary action and expulsion. Kron expected his father's influence to keep him out of trouble, but after Xina testified against him and Miguel tricked Kron into admitting he tried to kill him and then attacking him in front of the review board, Kron's fate was sealed. Tyler Stone tried to intimidate Angela into reversing the decision, but she refused to back down from him. Although Kron was expelled, it was implied Tyler did manage to get Angela fired from the school eventually. Years later, Angela was associated with an Indy Town known as Nightshade. They had developed some interesting tech dating back to recovered Heroic Age materials. Nightshade was attacked by corporate headhunters while Miguel and Xina were visiting Angela, and she died in the resulting explosion.

angela golden.origin: Golddigger was first observed as one of the costumed female criminals summoned to Superia's island as part of her plot to form an army of allies and sterilize the rest of the world, leaving her in power. Golddigger fought Captain America and his allies there, but left when Superia's plot was halted by them. Shortly thereafter, she was at a bar when Asp and Black Mamba began their search for Snapdragon. She was among those who attacked them for their interference with Superia's plans. Golddigger was contacted by a bartender in New Orleans when Diamondback and Zachary Moonhunter arrived and began questioning the whereabouts of Snapdragon. She pretended to offer them a lead, but then gassed them and brought them before her employer, Damon Dran's child-slavery ring. She was opposed by Captain America and Americop before attempting to flee aboard Dran's helicopter. She was climbing up its ladder when it was shot down and exploded by Americop. It is unknown if she is still alive.

angela stone.name: Angela Stone
angela stone.origin: Angela Stone was the aide to Attorney General Roger Mollech and was his main contact in a conspiracy with the dictator of Medisuela, Miguel Alfredo Navatilas, with whom he was concerned with redistributing the narcotics seized during police operations and with the money obtained to use in the sale of defective weapons to Navatilas. Stone and Mollech told Navatilas that Medisuela was to use these weapons in attacks against Medisuela's neighboring countries (Argentina and Paraguay) so that their policies aligned with Mollech's American allies' interests, which Navatilas agreed to if Mollech funded the operation - this was known as Project: Democracy. Mollech and Stone also convinced Navatilas they were spending resources to improve Navatilas' international public image, stained due to accusations of crimes. However, Mollech was conspiring against Navatilas, painting him as a criminal to have an excuse for the American military to invade Medisuela, then put a new puppet leader, under Mollech's control, there. To that end, Mollech was providing Medisuela with sabotaged weapons which would fail during the upcoming American invasion. Stone pretended to behave submissively, but kept strict control over everything, including Mollech's military rogue allies, the DIA. When both the Punisher and Captain America investigated parts of their conspiracy, Stone made contact with the Punisher pretending to be a repentant, manipulated weak bureaucrat, and made him believe that Captain America was involved in shady trade, so that the Punisher did the dirty work in eliminating Captain America, after which the DIA was sent to get rid of the Punisher himself. During a meeting between Navatilas and Mollech, Stone reminded Navatilas that he has image problems in the States but that the US government would have continued to sell him weapons if his country had opposed neighboring countries that did not accept American export democracy. After dismissing Navatilas, Stone directed Mollech the problem of the Punisher being considered a loose cannon even after taking out Captain America to their advantage, not knowing that Cap was not dead but had staged his funeral. Later Stone tortured and then killed a woman who had worked with DIA's Lykaios Theopolous in the weapons trade, discovering that enemy agents had obtained information about the arms trafficking with the Medisuela, then warned Mollech and Navatilas that there was a breach in their traffic that could compromise everything. Seeing the secret in danger, Mollech tried to force the United States to invade Medisuela, but was blocked by the Congress and the President; he then tried to force the invasion by having the DIA attack Medisuela - and asked Stone to prepare a escape route in case it failed. Stone told him she had already prepared that, in a plane taking off from Dallas. Captain America and the Punisher stopped the invasion and obtained information that incriminated Mollech. Mollech and Stone tried to escape with the money obtained from the shady trades done with Navatilas, but Captain America and the Punisher reached them before they managed to escape, and reached by the Punisher, Stone tried again to trick Frank by saying that she was just a tool and they were using her, but this time Frank didn't let her lies fool him and killed her with a gunshot.
abilities: Stone was an excellent bureaucrat and manager, and an experienced torturer. While attractive, Stone gave a cold image in most of her activities, but was also able to manipulate men by being seductive with a chance of attitude and attire
she did convince the Punisher this way. On the other hand, she also rejected Navatilas' romantic advances. Stone spoke English and Spanish.

angela wynoski.name: Angela Wynoski
angela wynoski.origin: Near the end of the Vietnam conflict, Angela Wynoski was head of the cryptography department in the U.S embassy in Saigon, where she became acquainted with two Marines, Frank Castle and Quincy Jefferson. Although she and Castle originally dated, Angela ultimately married Quincy. Fifteen years later, Angela was living in San Domingo, a corrupt Central American country, with Quincy, who was now a DEA agent investigating the country’s government. Also with them was their daughter Laura, and they were at some point took in Esteban Ramone, a runaway whose father was none other than the country's drug kingpin, Hector Ramone. Early in his career as the Punisher, Castle came to San Domingo with the intention of killing Captain De Ortega, the country’s official ruler and puppet of the drug cartels. He happened to be reunited with the Jeffersons, who had heard of the murder of Castle’s family half a year earlier. While Quincy was having a discussion over Castle’s intentions in San Domingo, a hit squad attacked the Jeffersons’ home, killing Angela and her husband, and kidnapping Laura. Swearing vengeance, the Punisher – aided by Esteban – rescued Laura and ultimately killed Hector Ramone. In the aftermath, Laura and Esteban were sent to live with Angela's sister in Idaho, while the Punisher completed his mission to assassinate Captain De Ortega.

angela yin.name: Angela Yin
angela yin.origin: Angela worked as a photographer for the Daily Bugle. She took pictures of a Cussler's fine China franchise store in Uptown, which was allegedly destroyed by the Scorpion. In Herald Square, she also caught on film Spider-Man attacking Phillip Cussler Sr. When Peter Parker was arrested, she and reporter Ben Urich interviewed the people who had known him the longest. She later introduced herself to Peter Parker, being a fan of his work. Angela followed reporter Ken Ellis to interview Mr. Tso at his own Club Noir, and was later saved by the Scarlet Spider from the Pro. Angela then mistook Ben Reilly as Peter Parker, thinking he was there undercover for an inside scoop on Tso. Yin also took pictures of the Scarlet Spider when he attached hundreds of weblines to the Daily Bugle Building and began to tear it down. Following the trail of destruction left by the Scarlet Spider, she then proceeded to Ben Reilly's home. Angela was then assigned by Jameson to investigate the Spider-Skeleton story with Ellis and Urich. A short time later, Angela met Mary Jane Watson when she visited the Daily Bugle Building with her husband Peter. Angela was among the many friends who visited Peter Parker when he was hospitalized after collapsing without any warning. She then found Mary Jane Watson-Parker at the New York Hospital, who was having complications with her baby. Back to the Daily Bugle, Angela witnessed the final battle between Spider-Man and the Green Goblin. She wished to follow Ben Urich when he was investigating on the Black Tarantula, but he was already meeting Parker. Angela met her cousin Meiko at the South Street Seaport carnival. She later introduced her to Robbie Robertson. Meiko was then ordered to kill Angela or be killed, but, when she received the opportunity, she fled.

angelica.name: Angelica
angelica.origin: Angelica is a friend of Ororo of Themyscira with psychic powers. Her "psychic flashes" are reportedly almost never wrong. One day she sensed that Ororo was in some kind of trouble. She did not know where her friend was, but she went to seek her in an old mansion in Baton Rouge, Louisiana. Ororo held an apartment there and Angelica had keys to it. She knocked on the door first. When Ororo failed to answer, Angelica used the keys to open the door. In Ororo's bedroom, Angelica found Diana of Themyscira. Diana was bruised and her clothes were torn. The two women did not recognize each other. They had no time for introductions either, since Diana passed out.

angelica neal.name: Angelica Neal
angelica neal.origin: Angelica Neal was born some time around the turn of the century. The daughter of Frank and Laurie Neal, she moved with her family to a lighthouse in Harrow's Point, Maine. While living there, Laurie fell under the thrall of the vampire Dracula. She began hearing voices in the middle of the night, beckoning her to the window. She caught a glimpse of the vampire lord, first in the form of a wolf, then again in the shape of a rat. The following evening, she heard a spectral voice and followed the summons down to the shore to the wrecked remains of a sailing vessel. Exploring the ship, she ran afoul of the captain, himself now a vampire due to an attack by the lord of the undead. The vampire attacked Angelica, but Dracula appeared and defended her, decapitating the other vampire in the process. With his competition out of the way, Dracula claimed Angelica as his own and drank of her blood. Her parents found her unconscious on the beach the following morning. The local physician examined her and determined that she was the victim of a vampire attack. A priest named Father McFarland placed a crucifix around her neck and laced the doors and windows of her room with garlic. That evening, Dracula came to her a second time, but McFarland and Laurie's father were ready for him. They succeeded in ultimately driving the vampire away and Angelica survived. Soon after, her father and she left Harrow's Point forever. What became of Angelica following this incident, or whether she is even still alive, is unknown. Notes: ; It is possible that Angelica may be a blood descendant of Dracula. At one point, he referred to her as "Flesh of my flesh, blood of my blood", but given Dracula's personality, it is just as likely that he may have simply been engaging in a bit of melodrama.

angelica rojas.name: Angelica Rojas
angelica rojas.origin: Angelica Rojas controlled an organization that was involved in human smuggling and drug trafficking (heroin mostly, sometimes cocaine or marijuana). That recruited the poorest and most desperate at the migrant camps, to swallow heroin balloons to smuggle into the United States. On one of the smuggling attempts, 19 men, women, and children died in a trailer on the U.S. side of the border carrying 10 lbs of heroin. Seeking justice for them, Wolverine swam across the Rio Grande into Mexico. After interrogating criminals, he stormed Angelica Rosa's mansion, taking out it's defenders. Only to find out the boss was a woman, and a pregnant one at that. Who admitted that the mules died and that she was responsible. Informing him that it was an accident, one that cost her time, money, and resources. She then told him that she was responsible for the deaths of dozens, some of them by her own hand and others on her orders. Wolverine left, after which she went into labor. He returned 20 hours later to find her in labor, alone as her guards were all dead or had fled because of him. She delivered the baby and then died, after which Wolverine took the child with him to the United States and would later give it to her sister.
powers: None, human.

Spider-Man and Daredevil were able to track where she would strike next, arriving just as Kutter and her gang had begun to "operate" on a cafeteria full of passed-out patrons. During the resulting battle, Angeline Kutter suffered a near-fatal injury when she accidentally slashed her own wrist with the scalpel she had been using for a weapon. angelique sasson.name: Angelique Sasson
angelique sasson.origin: Angelique Sasson was a young woman who was subjected to cyberbullying, which led to her despair and the decision to commit suicide. Layla Miller, seeing what was about to happen, decided to run to save her, but as she ran toward her, she intervened to help another woman defend herself from some street thugs. This action altered reality, but Layla decided to try to save her anyway. Having reached her on the roof where Angelique was about to jump, she called out to her, causing her to jump and stumble, falling from the roof. Layla leaped into the void to catch her and, using her force field device, managed to save them both. The near-death situation brought Angelique to her senses, and she resolved never again to attempt suicide because of four cyberbullies. Layla later saw two divergent realities because of what had happened: in one reality, Angelique became a researcher who discovered a medical methodology that led to the saving of Layla's husband, Jamie Madrox, while in the other reality, Jamie died.

angie turner.name: Angie Turner
angie turner.origin: Angie Turner had the ability to bring fictional characters from the Ideaverse to life and brought together the Frankenstein's Monster, D'Artagnan, Tom Sawyer, and Injun Joe together to live with her. Her next effort caused her a great deal of effort and a little pain, but she managed to summon Dracula to her presence. However, instead of summoning the fictional "Dracula" from Bram Stoker's novel, she instead brought the real Dracula, who was confused to find himself around an assemblage of fictional characters. However, Angie was very impressed, as she loved Dracula most of all of them. Dracula realized that Angie had summoned him and other fictional characters and that she loved Bram Stoker's novel. Dracula showed her utter contempt toward her love of Stoker's "inferior" adaptation of his diaries, and knocked the woman aside. This prompted the other fictional characters to come to her aid, Dracula finding it easy to fight them off. Even when she summoned Robin Hood and Zorro to help stop the fight, Dracula was still the superior of all of them. Realizing that Dracula in real life was nothing like her beloved character, she tossed her copy of Bram Stoker's Dracula into the fireplace, which surprisingly caused the real Dracula to be painfully sent back to where he had come from, appearing before his worried wife once more. It was revealed that the manor wasn't a real place at all, and that Angie was a mental patient who has been locked in a padded room ever since the death of her husband and child drove her insane. With the banishment of Dracula from her fantasy world, she let out a scream, prompting nurses to check on her and make sure she was all right. All was well indeed for Angie, for in her own little fantasy world she lived happily with the fictional characters she had come to love.

angry eagle.name: Angry Eagle
angry eagle.origin: Due to the decrease in anti-mutant sentiment, Jubilee found four exceptional heroes (the high flying Angry Eagle, the ape-like Simian, the stretchable Spanner, and the superfast Torque) to form her core team, the X-People. Angry Eagle and the X-People were briefly put under the sway of Enthralla, and attacked J2 when he arrived to inquire about a possible membership. The X-People were shocked back into their right minds by a clap-driven wave of cold water from J2, and they proceeded to apprehend Enthralla. When Nancy Lu's powers began to manifest, the X-People contacted her, and when she finally caved, Angry Eagle was there with his team to pick Nancy up as Spider-Girl watched her go. The X-People had some of their members kidnapped by Loki and manipulated and Angry Eagle was among the many heroes who survived the ordeal without any crippling injuries. He later helped to fight against Galactus when the planet eater came to Earth. After the Sisterhood of Mutants began to stalk a mutant girl named Sara Hingle, the X-People clued Jubilee in that a hate group may be involved. Later, when Hingle, calling herself Nucleus, went ballistic against the hate group Humanity First the X-People arrived to try to contain her but none of them were fast enough to penetrate Nucleus's energy bands. After Spider-Girl arrived and talked Hingle down, Magneta triggered Hingle's power remotely, releasing a massive energy burst that flattened Eagle and all those present.

angus.name: Angus
angus.origin: ===Origins=== thumb|left|Angus among the Tuatha warriors Angus, also known as Aengus of the Brugh, was a Celtic deity revered as the god of love and youth. As a member of the Tuatha de Danaan, he served as a warrior under the Dagda. Angus was a great adventurer and wielded the legendary sword Moralltach, known as the Great Fury. ===Modern Age=== thumb|150px|The Dagda asks for Angus' patience Recently, a giant troll, sent by the Fomorians, attacked a Tuatha village in Avalon. In response, the Dagda summoned Angus, Conor, and Cuthbadth to rally the Tuatha warriors and pursue their adversaries. The Dagda led his clan, including Angus and the others, to a cliff overlooking the Fomorians' camp. From this vantage point, they observed the hot-tempered god Leir, who had impulsively launched a direct assault on the Fomorians. Eager to join the fray, Angus asked the Dagda if they should join. However, the Dagda urged patience and chose a more strategic approach. Instead of engaging in direct combat, the Dagda conjured a swarm of hornets to disperse the Fomorians, avoiding unnecessary bloodshed.
weapons: Angus wielded the legendary sword Moralltach, known as the Great Fury.

In response, the Dagda summoned Angus, Conor, and Cuthbadth to rally the Tuatha warriors and pursue their adversaries. The Dagda led his clan, including Angus and the others, to a cliff overlooking the Fomorians' camp. From this vantage point, they observed the hot-tempered god Leir, who had impulsively launched a direct assault on the Fomorians. Eager to join the fray, Angus asked the Dagda if they should join. However, the Dagda urged patience and chose a more strategic approach. Instead of engaging in direct combat, the Dagda conjured a swarm of hornets to disperse the Fomorians, avoiding unnecessary bloodshed.

angus mcgregor.first_appearance: Nick Fury, Agent of SHIELD Vol 1 3
angus mcgregor.origin: Angus McGregor was the caretaker of Castle Ravenlock when Nick Fury came to investigate the grounds on behalf of his friend Ken Astor. Ken was already murdered by the time Fury arrived but he was able to put a stop to future killings when he boobytrapped their U-Boat to explode and collapse a tower on the secret hideout that belonged to a group of former Nazis. The Nazis were led by a man named Miles von Croff who had years earlier just after the war made a deal with Gavin Ravenlock the lord of Castle Ravenlock to supply him with treasures that his crew plundered from hapless victims in exchange for their relative safety on the grounds that belonged to him. Miles took up the name Mycroft and adopted a young female ward named Rachel and ended up murdering Gavin Ravenlock to keep his mouth shut. As Rachel had also grown older he attempted to kill her as well to keep his deal and identity from being known. After the mystery of the curse of Castle Ravenlock was solved Angus confessed to Rachel that she was his niece and that Mycroft only took her in after Angus' brother asked him to while on his deathbed from sickness and that her mother had already died in childbirth. With Mycroft dead Angus asked Rachel to live with him at Castle Ravenlock.

angus munro.name: Angus Munro
angus munro.first_appearance: Marvel Graphic Novel Vol 1 63: Spider-Man: Spirits of the Earth
angus munro.origin: Angus Munro allied with the Hellfire Club to exploit the crystal buried under Castle Duncraig. After kidnapping his uncle and nephew, Spider-Man confronted him. Unfortunately during the battle Hugh Munro was shot to death and Angus managed to flee to a cliff with his nephew. Eventually Spider-Man managed to catch up to them and, after a brief struggle, managed to defeat Angus. Admitting that he was as weak as the rest of his family, Angus decided that there was only one noble way to bring honor to himself. Before Spider-Man could stop him, Angus leapt off the edge of the cliff into the waters below. As soon as Spider-Man rescued Hugh and took him to safety, there was a sudden volcanic eruption in the cavern below them where Angus dropped, killing him and leaving Hugh Munro Jr. the heir of the Munro Clan.

anielle.name: Anielle
anielle.species: Ephemera (Angel created with a short lifespan for one specific purpose)
anielle.origin: Anielle was an Ephemera, a type of angel created with a limited lifespan and to fulfill a specific purpose. She fell to Earth on a beach near Miami, Florida, and her arrival was observed by many groups, including the demonic gangster Olivier Stoker. Stoker dispatched his infernal minions to capture the angel, but his plans were foiled by the mutant Gambit, who took it upon himself to protect Anielle from her pursuers and escort her to safety at the Vatican. After numerous attacks by demons, Anielle and Gambit reached Rome, where they were confronted by Stoker again and Sister Katrina, a nun he had corrupted. Stoker offered to release Katrina from his service if Anielle surrendered to him. Trusting in divine providence, Gambit agreed to the deal. Anielle, having apparently fulfilled her purpose of saving Katrina's soul, perished in a sudden burst of lightning. Stoker was destroyed alongside her. Anielle would be summoned and captured by the Blasphemy Cartel, who planed to torture her into their weapon against mutants but they were stopped by X-Force. As a reward for saving her, Anielle allowed Cable to select one soul for her to judge. He chose his teammate Hellverine, as he suspected him the most between him, Boom-Boom and Archangel to be Ms. Marvel's future assassin but Anielle confirmed that Hellverine was not Ms. Marvel's murderer.

animus hate monger.name: Animus (Hate-Monger)
animus hate monger.origin: The entity known as Hate-Monger (later as Animus) first appeared on a rooftop watching a riot between the reformed Sons of the Serpent, a radical hate group, and a band of demonstrators who were assembled outside the 41st Precinct Station House to protest the clubbing of Carmello Martinez. Martinez, a fifteen-year old boy, was violently beaten by police. The incident was videotaped by an alert bystander and given national media exposure. The New Warriors attempted to break the riot up and Rage, then a member of the Avengers, also got involved. Although the New Warriors observed that this was more than just a race riot, they were unaware that Hate-Monger was actually subtly manipulating their actions. Eventually, other Avengers showed up. Hate-Monger used his ability to read and control emotions to directly affect the battle. When the Sons of the Serpent pulled out in an attempt to cut their losses, Hate-Monger decided that the dance had played itself out and he went home to digest the hate he had consumed. The two teams of heroes went their separate ways, but using separate techniques, ended up at the same hideout of the Sons of the Serpent. The Avengers got there first and took out the supremacy group in a suspiciously short period of time; however, Hate-Monger ambushed them, revealing that he didn't fuel the riot, but rather fed off it. The New Warriors and Rage arrived, freeing the Avengers. Ultimately, the teams decided not to give Hate-Monger the antipathy he desired, and thwarted, Hate-Monger fled into the night, robbed of his power. A short time later, Hate-Monger attempted to destroy Nomad, but failed because Jack truly loved his adopted daughter, Bucky, for whom he wanted to become a better man.

abilities: Skilled orator, especially in promoting hatred and anger.

aningan kenojuak.name: Aningan Kenojuak
aningan kenojuak.origin: Aningan Kenojuak was an Inuit shaman who discovered the human figure trapped in the ice and thinking it was a deity he brought it to his village starting to worship it and convincing his village that it was a god and also thanks to some events that brought relief to the village which Aningan attributed in his presence the whole village began to worship him. Later the Sub-Mariner, following the defeat suffered by the Avengers, arrived at the village of Aningan and in anger, threw the figure into the ice in the middle of the sea, where it was found by the Avengers. That human figure turned out to be Captain America in suspended animation in ice from World War II. Aningan continued to request divine intervention until Kang noticed this, posed as a deity and gave Aningan an amulet that gave him a variety of powers. With his amulet he went to New York City and captured Captain America by imprisoning him in an energy block similar to ice, thus recreating his divine figure. Aningan was later defeated by the Avengers who destroyed the amulet and freed Captain America.

anita ehren.name: Anita Ehren
anita ehren.species: Human granted power by the Power Broker
anita ehren.origin: Not much is known about Battleaxe's history before she became a member of the Grapplers, the female division of the Unlimited Class Wrestling Federation. Along with the other Grapplers, Battleaxe apparently gained superhuman strength and durability thanks to being submitted by the Grapplers' manager Auntie Freeze for the Power Broker's strength-boosting treatments. One of Battleaxe's first acts in the group was to challenge its then leader Titania (now known as Lascivious) to about to decide who would lead the group. Battleaxe won, but soon after, Titania was shot and killed by one of the assassins known as the Scourge of the Underworld, who was disguised as a female wrestler. Battleaxe suspected the UCWF member the Thing of the killing and attacked him with the other Grapplers, but was stopped by their teammate Sharon Ventura, who convinced them of his innocence. Later, Battleaxe showed up as a member of Superia's all-female army of superhumans, the Femizons. While aboard Superia's ship heading to her island, Battleaxe was one of the many Femizons who attacked and captured the heroes Captain America and Paladin, who had been following the women. After the Femizons were defeated by Captain America and Paladin with the help of the mercenaries Diamondback, Black Mamba, and Asp, who had been reluctant recruits to the Femizons, Superia put a bounty out on the three women. Battleaxe and two other Femizons, Steel Wind and Golddigger came upon Asp and Black Mamba in a Bar with No Name and tried to bring them in, but they were defeated by the pair, who were helped by their new friend Impala. More recently, Battleaxe clashed with the heroine Ms. Marvel, but was again defeated.
abilities: Battleaxe is a trained and is apparently skilled at using axes in battle.
weapons: Battleaxe wields a pair of double-headed axes in combat.

anitun i triumph division.name: Anitun I (Triumph Division)
anitun i triumph division.origin: Anitun was a member of the generational Filipino superhero team the Triumph Division. All members of each generation trained their entire lives to replace their elders. In Anitun's case, she was the latest in a line of hosts of the divinity of the same name from the same bloodline. After the team provided the country with invaluable help during the crisis caused by a tsunami, the Triumph Division were honored with the construction of a statue in Plaza de Roma. At the public ceremony during which the members of the Triumph Division were commended, a group of monks broke the rope line and approached the superheroes. Being undercover suicide bombers genetically engineered by Ezekiel Stane, the monks held onto the members of the Triumph Division and charged up. Red Feather ordered Wishing Man to make them disappear, but before he could act, the monks exploded, obliterating the entire square and leaving no survivors. As the director of S.H.I.E.L.D., Iron Man attended the funerals for the members of the Triumph Division. Since all members of the team possessed secret identities, the services were only attended by their immediate families. Anitun's funeral was also attended by Thor since he was friends with the deity she hosted. Not long afterwards, the late members of the team were succeeded by their relatives, and the divinity Anitun transferred her life essence to a new host.
powers: As the embodiment of the Diwata Anitun, she possessed the ability to manipulate the weather, most notably creating , , and .

anitun ii triumph division.origin: Following the death of the previous generation of the familiar Filipino superhero group the Triumph Division at the hands of suicide bombers during a ceremony in Plaza de Roma, the next member in each of the deceased members' bloodlines succeeded them, following the team's centuries-old tradition. The deity Anitun transferred her life essence from her late host to a new woman of her bloodline. The members of the fledging generation were visited at the Triumph Hall by Iron Man to pay his respects. They were nervous and eager, but also hopeful, which reminded Iron Man of the early days of the Avengers. When Tony Stark became a prisoner of the Mandarin, his allies Pepper Potts and Bethany Cabe set up a meeting in international waters with the Triumph Division and the Chinese superhero team the Dynasty and requested their aid to take part in a rogue rescue operation to retrieve Stark from Mandarin City. Both teams were glad to help since Tony Stark had been present for them. The heroes arrived during the final battle between Iron Man and the Mandarin. While the Dynasty took down the Mandarin's armed forces, the Triumph Division engaged the Titanomechs until Iron Man used the Swarm to destroy them. Some time later, the Triumph Division prevented the Macronaut from making a landfall in Quezon City. After the defeat of Sindr, the Queen of Cinders, Anitun was with the other members of her team and Aero in Shanghai as they were being celebrated for their bravery for defending the Philippines and the rest of Southeast Asia.
powers: As the embodiment of the Diwata Anitun, she possessed the ability to manipulate the weather, most notably creating , , and .

anjulie.name: Anjulie
anjulie.origin: When the society climbing witch named Anjulie came to the court of the King, she used her magic to entice the King and to coerce him into asking for her to marry him. Once they were wed, she forced her step-daughter Kymri from the city and began to rule the planet with an iron fist and seemingly began to drain the world of its life force. She forced the king into the role of the High Priest. Also while ruling the planet, the Slavers began to fear her and to not poach in her territories. Anjulie used her magic on the King to disfigure and weaken him both physically and mentally until he was completely under her command. Thinking her father was dead, Kymri became the one person in the whole world that Anjulie feared and began a rebellion against her rule. Sometime later, during a battle between Anjulie's forces and the pirates under the command of Kymri, a flying train containing the members of Excalibur arrived in their reality and one of their members, Nightcrawler, was thrown from the train to land on the flying ship where the two forces her battling. Nightcrawler bested them, and an exhausted Kymri asked him if he knew what he had done. Nightcrawler was confused and was knocked out from behind by Anjulie. thumb|left|175px Anjulie informed Nightcrawler that he had saved her and that all of the pirates were killed in the battle, including Kymri before seducing him in her bathtub. Later, when they were in bed together, a servant named Pica accidentally spilled a drop of wine on her hand. Nightcrawler charmingly kissed it away but noticed that Pica was terrified for his life and started to suspect she was not what she seems. When Nightcrawler awakened after his evening of carnal pleasure with Anjulie, she was talking to her robed priest, suspected something was afoot and followed them to the dungeons of the ship. There, he found Pica had been tortured and Kymri imprisoned in a cell, who tried to kill him through the bars. Feeling guilty for backing the wrong side, Nightcrawler freed Kymri, and they tracked Anjulie to the bowels of the floating ship. There, the two find Anjulie and her High Priest worshipping a huge, tentacled creature that was draining the life out of Kurt's Excalibur teammates. Nightcrawler attacked the creature in order to save his teammates while Kymri went after Anjulie. thumb|left Kymri killed the High Priest who came to her defense but was devastated to see she had accidentally killed her own father, who has been deformed by Anjulie's magic. While Kymri was distracted, Anjulie attacked from behind and tried to stab her with a dagger but was herself killed by Shadowcat. The two women, however, were grabbed by the monster, who started to drain Shadowcat once again. Nightcrawler realized the monster was attracted to their mutant powers and threw Phoenix into the creature's mouth, since it had avoided her. His trick worked, and the creature was destroyed by the vast power of the Phoenix Force.
powers: Anjulie possessed an unknown aptitude of magical powers, mostly centered around summoning creatures with dark characteristics.

ankhesenamun.name: Ankhesenamun
ankhesenamun.origin: ===Origins=== Ankhesenamun was the daughter of Akhnaton. She was married to her father, and had intercourse with him. ===Marriage with Tutankhamon=== At nine years old, Akhnaton's brother (or son or step-son) Tutankhamun succeeded him and was married at the same time to Ankhesenaum, making her his wife, niece, and daughter-in-law, for her to be queen. Ankhesenamun, forced into that marriage, hated Tutankhamun. On their wedding night, Tutankhamun played with toys as his wife had intercourse with other men. Tutankhamun himself considered Akhenaten to be a pervert. At 17-years old, Tutankhamun was jealous of Ankhesenamun being "friendly" with all the men of the court, including Horemheb, while himself was denied, unlike Akhenaten. As he pressured Ankhesenamun, she presented him to her lover, a jackal-headed god whom Tutankhamun attempted to slay, only to be killed by a blast from the god's wand. After an instant of mourning where she shouted at the god to go away (which he did in a flying pyramid), and after stating the inconvenience of her lover's departure and of her husband's death, Ankhesenamun sent a missive to the King of the Hittites for him to send a grown-up son to be her new husband.

ankhi gottberg.name: Ankhi Gottberg
ankhi gottberg.origin: ===Origin=== Ankhi Gottberg was orphaned at an early age. This changed when her powers manifested, causing her hair to fall out and her skin to turn black. Horrified by her new appearance, Ankhi ran away from the orphanage, fearing that she would be thrown out. ===On the streets and drug-addict=== After spending a period on the streets, Ankhi met Sven, who introduced her to heroin. The two became lovers and were relatively happy together until their dealer, Bjorn, overdosed while they were at his house. Fearing that he was dead and that they would be accused of murder, they ran, but not before Sven stole Bjorn's stash in order to sell it later. Unbeknownst to them, Bjorn was revived shortly afterwards. Sven took Ankhi to his sister's house, where they hid out, but Sven's sister and her friends used up all the heroin and then kicked Sven and Ankhi out. Shortly after, a vengeful Bjorn caught up with Sven and killed him. The shock caused Ankhi's powers to kick in, causing her third eye to blind Bjorn and his enforcers, and thus allowing her to escape. Ankhi ended up on the streets, where she was arrested and thrown in jail. Still addicted to heroin, she spent several nearly-unbearable days getting clean. Afterwards, she was approached by a man from an unspecified organization who offered to help her master her powers. ===M-Day=== Her activities and whereabouts since then remain unrevealed, but she is presumed to be depowered since M-Day.

weaknesses: Ankhi's powers were suppressed or weakened by her heroin use.

ann barclay.name: Ann Barclay
ann barclay.origin: In 1944, Ann Barclay's plane went down in the Sahara desert over Egypt. Wandering the desert she unknowingly passed through a seemingly one-way portal into another dimension. There she would soon come to live in the "City of the Mirage" (also known as the Miracle City) a timeless realm where those trapped in this dimension would never age. About a year later, American soldier Kurt "Breeze" Barton, near death from dehydration, would also pass through the portal and would be nursed back to health by Ann. Ann would show Barton around, introducing him to the city's scientist Zanoba. After deducing that magnetism would be the means to get past the barrier and return to Earth, Zanoba would be captured by the evil Mubahn leader of the Demon People. Barton would slay Mubahn and rescue Zanoba. With the device to return home completed, Ann would agree to accompany Barton back to Earth . Upon their return home, they would be shocked to find that 50 years had passed and it was now the year 1995. The world would be in ruins due to ongoing war. They would join Jacques "Frenchie" Reliure's freedom fighters. After Breeze would win the leadership of a tribe of savages, the savages disposed chief would attempt to slay Breeze, however Ann would save his life . When Breeze would set up a fort to start their new civilization. It would come under attack by the evil raider named Sabarr. Following Breeze into battle, both he and Ann would be captured and taken prisoner. Breaking free, they would rejoin the fight and Sabarr would eventually be slain by Breeze. With the battle over, Breeze and Ann would leave to explore more of the Earth . Their current activities are unknown.
weapons: She is sometimes armed with a pistol

ann beckley.name: Ann Beckley
ann beckley.origin: Ann was an astronaut when she met Stephen (also a former astronaut). The two would fall in love, marry and have a son, Benny. Professionally, the were also the creators and heads of the Edmond Project, a joint effort by the National Aeronautics and Space Administration and the Massachusetts Institute of Technology to investigate astronomical events. As the culmination of the project, Stephen Beckley piloted a spacecraft that encountered an apparent comet passing through the solar system. Beckley lost directional control of his spacecraft; which was drawn into the tail of the comet, apparently dying. However, instead, he had an alien encounter and was granted great powers. Despite revealing that he was alive to their colleague David Hilbert, Hilbert allowed Ann to continue to believe her husband was dead and he quarantined Beckley, subjecting him to tests of his new superhuman abilities. Stephen Beckley later escaped captivity, unaware that his wife and son had also been made prisoners. Ann made an escape attempt, taking Benny with her, but was accidentally killed when she made contact with an electrical fence.

ann dodgson.name: Ann Dodgson
ann dodgson.origin: Ann Dodgson was married to Edward Stanford, and had a twin sister, Clare, who was a detective. Clare's testimony threatened the local crimelord, Nemesis, so Nemesis' goons abducted Stanford and invaded his home, taking Ann and her kids hostage. Coming to their house for dinner, Clare was alerted to the situation by the natural mental link she shared with her twin. Clare got the jump on the thugs, and soon the Unipower joined the fight, turning both sisters into Captain Universe simultaneously. The Captains Universe used a combination of their powers and Clare's investigative skills to track down Nemesis' hideout, defeat his hoods, and corner the boss, but Ann's husband was nowhere to be found. When they unmasked Nemesis, it was revealed to have been Stanford all along, playing both sides of the law as crimelord and D.A. Disgusted, Ann punched him out and let the police take him away. The sisters returned to the Stanford home and the Unipower departed as Ann prepared to take on the challenge of raising her children alone.

ann fraley.name: Ann Fraley
ann fraley.origin: Ann Fraley was a professional female wrestler in her youth, wrestling under the name 'Auntie Freeze'. After retiring as a wrestler herself, she became the manager to a group of four younger female wrestlers, Davida DeVito (known as Titania), Melissa Gold (known as Screaming Mimi), Marian Pouncy (known as Poundcakes), and Hellen Feliciano (known as Letha), who collectively became known as the Grapplers. The Grapplers' careers, however, weren't as successful as their male counterparts, however, and they drifted into petty crime. Eventually, the four wrestlers made a deal with the criminal Roxxon Oil company, who gave the women special powers and equipment so they could commit crimes on their behalf. The Grapplers' schemes were often thwarted, however, and they were imprisoned at least once. Eventually, Auntie Freeze was approached by the Power Broker, who offered her the chance to have her clients' strength increased to superhuman levels thanks to his strength-boosting treatments, Auntie Freeze agreed, and the Grapplers' strength was increased. Auntie Freeze also recruited a number of other female wrestlers to join the Grapplers and had their strength boosted too. As a result, the Grapplers were eligible to join the Unlimited Class Wrestling Federation and became its female division, welcoming the respectability it provided, away from their life of crime. Shortly thereafter, two of the Grapplers, Titania and Letha, were murdered by the assassins known as the Scourge of the Underworld (though they were later mystically resurrected). The Grapplers and the UCWF eventually disbanded, with many of the Grapplers turning to crime (and in the case of Melissa Gold eventually becoming a superhero under the name of Songbird). Auntie Freeze's current activities are unknown.
abilities: Ann Fraley was a trained as a young woman, and presumably retained much of this knowledge even as an elderly woman.

ann keats.name: Ann Keats
ann keats.origin: Dracula walked into a disco bar, where he met a woman named Ann Keats. Keats explained that she was recently divorced and invited Dracula to come home with her. Along the way. she told Dracula her life story. When she asked what Dracula was doing in New York City, he told her that he was looking for his daughter. When she asked if he knew where she was, he told her he did not. Ann followed after him, and the two were soon attacked by muggers. Despite the fact that they were outnumbered and Dracula was injured in the fight, Dracula easily defeated their attackers. When Ann asked how he did that, Dracula told her his real name. When he heard police sirens, he told her he must go. Ann took him back to her home, unaware that they were being stalked by the 'Cowboy'. At Ann's apartment, Dracula told her his life story, however she found it more than a little hard to believe. Noticing that she had a phone, Dracula asked if he might call his wife Domini. He told Domini what he was doing in New York and although she accepted it, she was saddened that Dracula would wish to turn himself back into a vampire. After Dracula was off the phone, the Cowboy burst into Ann's apartment with guns blazing. As Ann called the cops for help, Dracula managed to get the better of the Cowboy in a hand-to-hand fight. The battle ended with Dracula throwing the bounty hunter off the roof of the apartment building to his death. Ann came to his side to tell Dracula that an ambulance was on its way as Dracula passes out from blood loss.

ann norton.name: Ann Norton
ann norton.origin: Anne Norton lived in the town of Sundown, Arizona with her father during the days of the American Frontier. When she was 18 years old she began dating Clay Harder who was becoming a well reputed as a fast draw and a great shot. Soon outlaws came to Sundown to try and make a reputation for themselves by trying to outdraw Harder. After an outlaw named Diego Simms tried his luck while Clay was out with Anne for dinner one night, her father was witness as Clay won the fight. Forbidding his daughter to see a gunfighter, Mr. Norton slapped Clay across the face. Shammed, Clay left town and he eventually became the legendary Two-Gun Kid . Many years later, Sundown was terrorized by the Dalton gang prompting Anne to send out a letter asking the Two-Gun Kid for help. Before he arrive, Anne and her father were harassed by the gang, and local banker Jeff Smith came to her defence but the outlaws just shoved him aside. The Kid soon arrived in town and subdued the Dalton gang. While Anne still harboured feelings for the Kid, her father's long ago recriminations still stuck to him and told her that she shouldn't be a gunfighter, suggesting that she pursue a romance with Jeff Smith before riding out of her life seemingly for good . Anne's subsequent activities are unknown.

anna ameyama.name: Anna Ameyama
anna ameyama.origin: ===Origins=== Anna Ameyama was an aspiring chef who learned many of her culinary skills from her uncle, Edwin Jarvis. After completing her courses at the Culinary Institute, she cooked in kitchens all over the world, including the U.S., Taiwan, Japan, Italy, and Mexico. After "paying her dues", she decided to try her luck on her own and began operating a food truck in New York City. Unfortunately, her truck was destroyed by Iron Man during a battle with Fin Fang Foom. After he came back to check up on her, he tried one of her tortas and was so impressed he hired her as his new chef. ===Working for Tony Stark=== On her first day of work for Stark Industries, Anna met her new robotic assistant M.I.K.A. Together, Anna and M.I.K.A. created a miso-hinted clams with pasta for Tony Stark and his guest, Emma Frost. Not long after starting work at Stark Industries, Anna was flown to Connecticut to cater Janet Van Dyne's birthday dinner with Tony, Thor, She-Hulk, Black Panther, Tigra, and Captain America in attendance. Using a secret recipe from her uncle, Anna cooked barbecue glazed chicken with a chili mustard marinade, cornbread, and coleslaw. On Halloween, Anna was tasked with creating a menu for the annual "Halloween F.E.A.S.T. Feast". Despite Tony suggesting pumpkin spiced waffles, Anna created a pumpkin-squash soup with a balsamic reduction that allowed everyone to customize their own "jack-o'-lanterns". Anna was especially busy during the week of Thanksgiving preparing for Stark's numerous Thanksgiving dinners, but she was able to rest on the Friday after Thanksgiving. Using leftovers, Anna and her roommate M'Betu created Thanksgiving dumplings. Thoroughly impressed by her cooking at Janet's birthday, Thor brought Anna to Asgard to cater a birthday feast for his mother, Lady Freyja. At Thor's request, Anna and Alida made a vegan succotash. Around Christmas, Tony Stark finally made good on replacing Anna's food truck. However, now she was left with a decision to make: stay working with Stark Industries or go out on her own. Needing guidance, Anna decided to turn to her Uncle Jarvis.

anna anokhin.name: Anna Anokhin
anna anokhin.origin: Black Widow received the call to atone for one of her acts as an assassin: years ago she killed a young scientist named Peter Anokhin in front of his wife. Clint knew about it and insisted on going with her. Spider-Woman didn't like the idea of her boyfriend going off alone with his ex so she insisted on coming along as well. They headed to Siberia to meet up with Anokhin's widow Anna, but she wanted nothing to do with Natasha. The marker was actually sent by her daughter Galina's boyfriend Karl, who wanted the Black Widow's help to find Galina, whom Anna believed to be dead. Reunited with her daughter thanks to the Black Widow, Anna still doesn't want to see Natasha ever again, but nonetheless offered her thanks in the form of Peter's journal, consisting of formulae and antidotes for everything they were working on, as well as personal notes to give Natasha some insight into the kind of man he was.

anna brisson.origin: Anna Brisson was a member of the Killgrave Support Group who was there the night Jessica Jones came in hopes of finding some clues to the location of Zebediah Killgrave. When it was Anna's turn to speak, Jessica did not believe her testimony, and accused Anna of being a liar, which got Jessica kicked out of the group. thumb|left|Anna flying away from the fight Jessica stayed behind in order to follow Anna home, and as she made her way down a dark alley, Jessica lost sight of her until a hard punch to the face knocked Jessica into a dumpster. She realized that Anna had some sort of abilities, since she was able to go toe-to-toe with her, and ended up getting the upper hand by chocking Jessica. Jessica countered Anna and shoved her to the ground, so that she could tell her all she wanted to do was have a coffee with her, but Anna got out of there quickly by flying away. A report on the news, which Jessica was watching later that night, mentioned that Anna had killed herself by jumping off a building, but since she was known to be a Nuhuman with the the ability to fly, the reporter questioned whether it was a real suicide as Anna seemingly had no history of depression nor mental illness. Jessica later went to Anna's parents' home to find any clues about the incident, but Anna's father slammed the door in her face and was then seen through the window telling his grieving wife that the vultures never give up.

anna coye.name: Anna Coye
anna coye.origin: Anna Coye was a friend of Miguel O'Hara. Miguel accompanied Anna to visit her sister Carrie who was admitted to ESU Hospital due to her degenerative genetic disease. While there there was an assault on the hospital by Mutagen who wanted to eliminate all genetic aberrations, so Miguel came out of Carrie's room with an excuse and transformed into Spider-Man to confront Mutagen, but during the fight, the two contenders broke through the ceiling of Carrie's bedroom knocking Anna out with the rubble. When Anna came to, the fight between Spider-Man and Mutagen was over and Anna found Carrie safe and sound. A few days later Anna and Miguel took a tour of Helix, a subsidiary of Alchemax, which had developed a prototype DNA scanner. During the tour, Mutagen stormed the Helix building with the intention of stealing the prototype so that he could easily find those people he considered genetic aberrations. During the assault, Mutagen recognized Anna and thought that since her sister had a genetic disease she too must have the same genetic disorder and was therefore intent on killing her; Miguel defended her but was hit by Mutagen when he was not yet transformed into Spider-Man so that Anna saw that Miguel could adhere to the walls. While trying to escape, taking advantage of the moment that Mutagen and Spider-Man were fighting, she was hit in the head by the rubble thrown by Mutagen that knocked her unconscious and when she awoke she discovered that she had suffered a head injury that had caused her a form of amnesia, thus not remembering the moments of Mutagen's attack and therefore also of Miguel's powers.

anna frankenstein.name: Anna Frankenstein
anna frankenstein.origin: The direct relation between Anna Frankenstein and her father to the legendary Frankenstein family is unknown. They took up residence in Castle Frankenstein following the death of Basil Frankenstein. Anna became loyal to the Nazis' cause and after becoming the love to a blind Nazi agent named Von Rottz, she became determined to use the family secrets to create her own version of the Frankenstein's Monster. After successfully creating the new monster without her father's knowledge, Anna sent a letter to Captain America and Bucky asking for their "assistance" so that she could set her creation against them. When the two heroes arrived, Anna begged them to investigate some "strange happenings" around the house in the hopes of using her monster to kill them. Later that night, Captain America and Bucky were attacked by the monster but forced it to flee. Cap gathered the Doctor, Anna, and his staff and went to search for the monster with the aid of Von Rottz. The creature attacked the heroes again and strangled Von Rottz to death. He then grabbed Anna and fled into the countryside. Captain America followed after the creature and freed Anna then tricked the monster into walking over a quicksand pit. Cap then confronted Anna with the truth, and in shame, she committed suicide by jumping into the quicksand as well. Unable to tell Frankenstein that his daughter was a traitor, Cap informed the Doctor that his daughter was killed by the monster before he could rescue her. Blaming Anna's death on the family curse, the Doctor then set the castle's laboratory on fire. The destruction of the lab did not destroy all of Victor Frankenstein's work as other members of his family have since been able to carry on their work.

fields.history: The direct relation between Anna Frankenstein and her father to the legendary Frankenstein family is unknown. They took up residence in Castle Frankenstein following the death of Basil Frankenstein. Anna became loyal to the Nazis' cause and after becoming the love to a blind Nazi agent named Von Rottz, she became determined to use the family secrets to create her own version of the Frankenstein's Monster. After successfully creating the new monster without her father's knowledge, Anna sent a letter to Captain America and Bucky asking for their "assistance" so that she could set her creation against them. When the two heroes arrived, Anna begged them to investigate some "strange happenings" around the house in the hopes of using her monster to kill them. Later that night, Captain America and Bucky were attacked by the monster but forced it to flee. Cap gathered the Doctor, Anna, and his staff and went to search for the monster with the aid of Von Rottz. The creature attacked the heroes again and strangled Von Rottz to death. He then grabbed Anna and fled into the countryside. Captain America followed after the creature and freed Anna then tricked the monster into walking over a quicksand pit. Cap then confronted Anna with the truth, and in shame, she committed suicide by jumping into the quicksand as well. Unable to tell Frankenstein that his daughter was a traitor, Cap informed the Doctor that his daughter was killed by the monster before he could rescue her. Blaming Anna's death on the family curse, the Doctor then set the castle's laboratory on fire. The destruction of the lab did not destroy all of Victor Frankenstein's work as other members of his family have since been able to carry on their work.

anna kapplebaum.name: Anna Kapplebaum
anna kapplebaum.species: Anna grew up in a Nazi concentration camp during World War II.
anna kapplebaum.origin: left|thumb|Anna at Diebenwald, 1945 Anna Kapplebaum was born in Germany in the year 1926. On November 9th, 1938, Nazi Germany initiated a pogrom which became known as Kristallnacht (the Night of Broken Glass). SS soldiers rioted the streets, collecting Jewish families and herding them into freight trains. Anna’s family was loaded on board and told that they were being taken to a distant work camp “for their own protection”. They remained in a cramped train cabin for three days until they reached Diebenwald. Anna soon learned that Diebenwald was not a work center, but a death camp. The old and infirm were executed immediately, and the able-bodied were put to work. The commandant of the camp was a fierce soldier named Colonel Steiger. Anna's parents were executed and she was separated from her brothers and sisters. In the Spring of 1945, Germany realized that the war was nearly lost, and the Allied Forces would soon liberate the concentration camps. Colonel Steiger ordered all records destroyed and all witnesses executed. Before such a task could be met, however, the patriotic hero Captain America stormed the gates of Diebenwald and attacked the Nazis. Colonel Steiger grabbed Anna Kapplebaum as a hostage and held a gun to her head. Cap flung his shield, disarming Steiger, then punched him until he fell unconscious. He took nineteen-year-old Anna in his arms and told her that the war was over. Years later Anna immigrated to the United States. As an elderly woman, she took up residence in a first level apartment at 569 Leaman Place in Brooklyn Heights. She became somewhat of a surrogate mother to many of the other tenants including Josh Cooper and Steve Rogers. Upon meeting Rogers, Anna felt a close kinship with him, little realizing that he was the same man who rescued her from the Nazi death camps nearly half a century earlier. At a butcher shop, Anna ran into Doctor Mendelhaus, one of the Nazis who had tortured her when she was in Diebenwald. She fainted at his sight and later woke up in a hospital bed. There she was visited by Aaron Heller and his daughter Marie, a Nazi hunter who was after Mendelhaus. After she left the hospital, Anna was kidnapped by a group of Nazis who worked together with Mendelhaus and brought her to him before she could assist in his capture. Luckily, she was saved just in time by Captain America and Aaron and Marie Heller.
abilities: Cooking: Anna is a kind-hearted and caring woman and is a gifted cook. Music: Anna can play the violin.

fields.unusual_features: Anna has a serial number "3456011" tattooed upon the top of her right forearm. It was a common practice during World War II for Nazi officials to tattoo Jewish prisoners with registry numbers in order to identify them.

anna reynolds.name: Anna Reynolds
anna reynolds.origin: When Dracula rode a train from Germany to Transylvania, he attempted to feed on a young mother named Anna Reynolds, but was interrupted by the intervention of his foes, the vampire hunters Frank Drake and Rachel van Helsing. They chased off Dracula before finding that the woman was okay, and that Dracula did not take enough blood to change her into a vampire. They went after Dracula, and the woman was long be forgotten by her attacker and rescuers. She was brought to a hospital and was diagnosed with severe anemia, however she would eventually recover. She went on with her life and eventually meet Peter McDonald, a computer salesman. The two fell in love, got married, relocated to America, and had a daughter named Jacqueline Louise McDonald. One day while out on Miami Beach with her mother, Jacqueline was attacked by a dog that got loose from its owner, leading to the girl to be hospitalized and require blood transfusions as she was rapidly losing white blood cells in much the same fashion as her mother had when she was attacked by Dracula all those years ago. In some strange twist of fate, the girl was somehow linked to Dracula, who was also greatly weakened and forced to feed on more than his usual number of victims. Believing their daughter to be possessed, the McDonalds sought out priests to perform exorcisms but were refused as the priests they approached didn't believe in possession by the devil. They got the aid of a elderly gypsy medium however who agreed to see their daughter and, although with some resignation from the hospital staff, was allowed to try and cure the girl. At the hospital, the gypsy lit a special candle that revealed that the girl was linked to Dracula, a revelation that did not surprise Anna in the slightest. Just then Dracula appeared in the hospital and began fighting his way to the girl's room. When a security guard attempted to stop him, Dracula forced him to turn the gun and shoot himself in the head. Sensing Dracula's presence coming closer, the force inside Jacqueline erupted with mystical energy, furious that the vampire would come to take back the blood that it had stolen from him. It broke free from its bonds and when Anna tried to go to her child, she was knocked back by the mystical force within the child. The creature within the girl fought off her parents until Dracula arrived and demanded that the creature give back his stolen power. When Anna attempted to separate the creature from her daughter by showing love, the creature proved too strong and Dracula interceded. During the altercation, a sudden flare of energy shot across from young Jacqueline and struck Dracula's brow, knocking him out the window. With Dracula gone, Anne saw that her daughter had been restored to normal.

anna sablinova.name: Anna Sablinova
anna sablinova.first_appearance: Silver Sable and the Wild Pack Vol 1 1
anna sablinova.origin: Anna Sablinova was the daughter of Fritz Sablinov, twin brother and second-in-command to Ernst Sablinova of the Wild Pack, a Symkarian military team that hunted Nazi war criminals. Fritz went missing, working undercover, and later Ernst was believed killed. Ernst's daughter Silvija (who adopted the nickname "Silver Sable") became Anna's sole legal guardian. Silver immediately sent Anna to an American private boarding school, Cranewood School for Girls in Northampton, Long Island, an exclusive (and expensive) place where Anna would have the best possible education, along with the daughters of several important politicians. As it was an all-girls school and teenage Anna would have liked to be around handsome males, she was far from delighted there. The dormitory of the school Anna was at, was taken hostage by Hydra terrorists, led by Silver's former lover Dmitri Petrovich, who demanded the release of dozens of international criminals. In an attempt to force the authorities' hand, Petrovich ordered to execute one of the students, Sarah, while Anna watched helplessly with her other classmates. At that juncture a courageous Anna had the courage to respond to Petrovich, shouting to him that the Hydra was no better than the Hitler's goosestepping Nazi pigs. When Hydra's goons stopped responding due to Silver and her allies confronting them, Anna foresaw that Petrovich would be defeated, and Petrovich answered by taking Anna as his personal hostage, a gun on her head. Sable and her ally Spider-Man burst in, and Anna called Silver "Aunt Silver", thus revealing to Petrovich how valuable she was as a hostage. Still, Petrovich got distracted at a critical moment, and Sable disarmed him by throwing a chai at his armed left hand; Anna then bit Petrovich's right hand with which he was holding her. Spider-Man offered to beat Petrovich up for threatening a small girl, but Sable took care of Petrovich. After humiliatingly defeating Hydra, Silver however refused to show affection to Anna, or to hear her pleas to take her to Symkaria, insisting that Anna was to make the most of the investment Silver was making on her education, at least while Anna was still a minor. A short time later, Anna surprised Silver Sable by going to the Symkarian Embassy in New York City just as Silver was about to go out for a gallant evening with her lover Jacques Girard; Silver's uncle Mortimer received Anna, but Silver insisted that Anna was too young to go away in New York City by night. Left alone at the embassy and crying on the roof, Anna surprised the international thief Black Fox who was sneaking into Symkaria's embassy to rob it. Anna then showed excellent resourcefulness and athletic skills and managed to keep up with the famous thief, using Silver's chai, a magnesium flare and small balls, along with traps and the Embassy's security system, while everyone else was helpless - the Fox had used a narcotic gas to disable the staff, but Anna had been on the roof at that point. In the end, however, the Black Fox eventually got the better of Anna and left her hanging by her feet in the embassy until Silver Sable returned. Silver, who had had a bad night, decided to leave there like that for a while. Sable still refused to let Anna live in Symkaria. Years later, Silver sent Anna to a new, still expensive, school, paying for it with her mercenary activities, though, after a revolution in Symkaria, her status had changed and she no longer could count on the Wild Pack. While investigating a string of murders of criminals in New York City, Silver contacted with Anna via a tablet to ask her to look for connections between four victims. As she had found nothing of notice, Anna on her own expanded the search to also include dozens of recently missing and mysteriously-deceased criminals, and found that NYPD's Rafael Scarfe and his units had investigated every one of them, pointing to Scarfe as a main suspect. This information helped Silver and her allies arrest Scarfe.

annabelle adams.name: Annabelle Adams
annabelle adams.origin: Annabelle Adams was a bartender and singer at the Four Seasons Hotel in Houston, where the fugitive Kaine had taken up residence. After long nights, Kaine often visited the bar, where Annabelle was immediately drawn to the mysterious man, though he largely ignored her flirtations. Through Kaine's involvement with Aracely Peña, a young girl he rescued from human traffickers and later brought to the hotel, Annabelle was asked to help translate, as she spoke Spanish. During Aracely's recovery, she and Annabelle formed a close friendship. Annabelle comforted the girl during the emergence of her strange psychic powers and prophetic dreams, even being present during one of her episodes. While watching a news report one evening, Aracely accidentally revealed that Kaine was the Scarlet Spider, shocking Annabelle. As part of Kaine's new supporting circle in Houston, Annabelle became one of several recurring allies including Aracely, Dr. Donald Meland, and Officer Wally Layton, who grounded the fugitive hero in a makeshift family. She frequently served as a moral anchor, helping to temper his violent impulses and offering him a glimpse of the life he longed for but struggled to maintain. left|200px|thumb Annabelle continued to cross paths with Kaine's dangerous double life. While she was performing in a church concert with her band, Ana Kravinoff tracked Kaine there and set the building ablaze during their fight, forcing Annabelle and the crowd to flee. Despite being caught in the chaos of his vigilante career, including his battle with Carnage during the Minimum Carnage event, she gradually grew closer to Kaine, often softening his violent impulses and giving him perspective. Annabelle's connection to Kaine deepened when she was taken hostage during a robbery by men dressed as Santa Claus at the Four Seasons Hotel. After convincing the robbers to bring her to Kaine's room, she was saved when he donned his Scarlet Spider costume and defeated them. She later aided Kaine and Aracely during their investigations into human trafficking in Houston. right|300px|thumb|Annabelle at the Rodeo Over time, Annabelle developed romantic feelings for Kaine. The two shared their first kiss at a rodeo, beginning a brief relationship. anne benson.name: Anne Benson
anne benson.origin: Nothing has been revealed about the past of Anne Benson. As a young woman, Benson worked as a technician at an unnamed laboratory. She casually dated one of the scientists who worked at the lab, a short-statured man named Howard Lindley. Howard was in love with Anne, but was too self-conscious to admit his true feelings to her, and convinced himself that Anne only went out with him out of pity. After years of being ridiculed for his stature, Howard was day-dreaming about being strong and tough like Bruttu, a large monster in one of his comic books, thinking that being so strong would help to impress Anne. Howard accidently activated a new machine in the lab, and was exposed to atomic rays, and was transformed into Bruttu, and ended up destroying the lab with his new body. After being attcked for his menacing appearance, Howard attempted to see Anne one last time. When he found her, Anne was terrified, and came to the conclusion that the monster had killed "the man she loved," believing that the monster had killed Howard in the lab. Realizing that Anne had loved him all along, Howard returned to the lab and changed himself back into a human. When Anne found Howard alive, she embraced him, and lived happily ever after.
